chapters.title: Chapter 174 - Big Yellow’s Head
paragraphs: Hearing what Jiang Chen said, Big Yellow’s face was instantly filled with an excited expression. He leapt forwards with his strong body, and by using his metal-like dog head, he rammed towards the huge hand made from Wang Yu’s Yuan energy.
Bang!
Energies were boiling, the huge hand of Yuan energy couldn’t withstand Big Yellow’s head, it was destroyed just like a huge bubble.
“What?!”
Wang Yu exclaimed. When Big Yellow attacked, only he could feel how powerful his opponent was. The energy Big Yellow unleashed was way more powerful than Wang Yu’s.
He had underestimated the enemy this time!

Wang Yu knew he had underestimated his opponent, therefore, he dared not neglect any longer. He immediately drew out a bright shining long sword and slashed out dozens of beams with his sword which weaved into a gigantic web. With the sword in the center, he forcefully attacked Big Yellow.
“Kaka, your grandfather’s head is as hard as metal, it is not something your broken sword can harm! You are too weak.”
Big Yellow was laughing out loudly. Every everyone’s frightened gazes, he rammed towards the sword with his head.

His action had even made Jiang Chen feel shocked. The sword carried by Wang Yu wasn’t an ordinary weapon, it was a razor sharp mid-ranked combat weapon. Although Big Yellow’s head was really hard, Jiang Chen didn’t think it was hard enough to take on a mid-ranked combat weapon.
“Haha, you are just courting death!”
Even Wang Yu was laughing out loudly now. In his mind, no matter how strong Big Yellow was, there was no way he could use his head to fight a mid-ranked combat weapon.

But too bad, Big Yellow had disappointed him. Just before his head was about to collide with the sword, a mystical symbol suddenly appeared in between his eyes. With the help of this symbol, Big Yellow’s head immediately covered by a golden light.
Clang!
What happened shocked everyone. When Wang Yu’s mid-ranked combat weapon collided with Big Yellow’s head, the sword instantly broke.
“What?”
Wang Yu and all the other Green Sanctuary Sect disciples who came here to watch the fight shouted out in disbelief at the same time.
However, Big Yellow’s speed was too great, and he didn’t give Wang Yu any time to react. With his head glowing in a golden light, he rammed into Wang Yu’s chest in the next second.
Bang!
Wang Yu became like a kite which had is string cut. He was sent flying in a straight direction, and he broke a few huge trees before he was finally thrown onto the ground.
After colliding with Big Yellow’s head, this result was expected. His head could even break a mid-ranked combat weapon, let alone a human being.
Wang Yu was coughing blood when was thrown onto the ground, there were even fragments of his internal organs mixed in with the blood. His chest had completely caved in.
Plop!
Wang Yu fell flatly onto the ground, he was now dead. Being killed by a dog’s head was just too annoying, he couldn’t die in peace at all.
Wa!

Everyone were shocked, all the disciples’ eyes widened, and their faces were filled with expressions of disbelief. Wang Yu was a Late Heavenly Core inner circle disciple, and with his Late Heavenly Core cultivation base, he had quite a prominent position in the inner circle, and he hardly found any matches. But still, he was today killed by a dog's head. This was too brutal.
Ahhhh!!
The female disciple couldn’t stop herself from crying out in fear. She thought Wang Yu could defeat the enemies, she had never expected this would happen.
“Let’s go.”
Jiang Chen said with an indifferent tone. After that, he brought Big Yellow with him and walked deeper into Misty Mountain, soon after, he disappeared from the people’s sight.
“They didn’t kill me? I’m still alive?”

The female disciple murmured to herself. She was blanked out just now due to fear. The enemy had killed three men in such a short amount of time, and she thought she would be killed as well, but she never expected he life would actually be spared. She felt lucky she was able to survive from this.
All the outer circle disciple looked at each other with awful expressions.
“Who was that young man? How does he have the audacity to kill Green Sanctuary Sect disciple in Misty Mountain?”
“That dog was too frightening, even senior disciple Wang Yu couldn’t withstand a single attack from it! How can we continue our training with such a powerful demon lord here?”
“We have to inform the Sect Elders about this and have that man killed!”

“Don’t panic, it’s not long before the inner circle disciples’ training begins. This incident will surely alarm our inner circle Divine Core Sect Elders, they will completely seal off the mountain and kill this man and dog!”

All the disciples were discussing the matter. The Green Sanctuary Sect had occupied the Misty Mountain for such a long time, and never in history had something like this happened. In Misty Mountain, unless they provoked the Firethorn Savage, no one would dare attack any disciple of the Green Sanctuary Sect.

Not long after that, another two figures came in from afar and landed in Misty Mountain. An old man and a young man. The young man was the inner circle disciple who went back to the Green Sanctuary Sect to inform the Sect Elders about what happened. His name was Xu Yun, and similar to Wang Yu, he was a Late Heavenly Core warrior. The Sect Elder who followed him here was an inner circle Sect Elder, a strong warrior at the Early Divine Core realm.
Both men immediately saw the dead bodies on the ground, and Wang Yu who had died a horrible death not far away.
“What?! Even Wang Yu was killed?! What a maniac, I will kill him with a thousand cuts!”
The old man instantly became enraged.

“Looks like that dog is really strong, even Wang Yu wasn’t its match. Luckily I went back and invited a Divine Core Sect Elder and didn’t act recklessly like Wang Yu. If I hadn’t, then I would have been dead like him now.”
Xu Yun felt lucky in his mind.
“How did Wang Yu die?”
Xu Yun turned to those Mortal Core outer circle disciples and asked.

“Senior disciple Xu, Wang Yu was killed by a dog! It had a very strong head, and it broke senior disciple Wang’s mid-ranked combat weapon! He was killed when the dog rammed its head into him! As for that young man, he didn’t attack at all, but judging from his age, I don’t think he is that strong, he’s just being protected by that dog!”
An outer circle disciple described what happened just now. When they recalled how brutal that dog was, all of these disciples felt chills down their spines.
“What? That dog’s head is that powerful?”
Xu Yun was shocked.
“Where did that young man and dog go?”
The Divine Core Sect Elder asked.
“They went deeper into Misty Mountain not long ago.”
A disciple pointed towards the direction where Jiang Chen and Big Yellow went.
“Hmph! What a maniac, how dare they challenge the Green Sanctuary Sect? They have no idea what death means! I will strike myself and kill them!”

The old man let out a cold snort. In the blink of an eye, he started flying towards the deeper area of Misty Mountain. Xu Yun moved at the same time and followed behind the old man. With the help of a Divine Core Sect Elder, the dog would perish this time. Xu Yun could help kill that young man in white.

The young man only had an ordinary cultivation base, and he had never attack before. He also looked pretty young. That was the only description Xu Yun had for Jiang Chen. Therefore, he had all his attention focused on the dog, and didn’t really care too much about Jiang Chen.
However, what Xu Yun didn’t know was, misleading information like this would get himself killed.
Bang!
Within the second sector of Misty Mountain, a violent banging sound shook the place. Jiang Chen had just killed a Late Heavenly Core demon lord and retrieved its demon soul.

With the help of the Dragon Transformation skill, the demon soul was absorbed by him in an instant. With his current cultivation level, the demon soul of an Early or Mid Heavenly Core demon beast was useless. But, the demon soul of a Late Heavenly Core demon lord could still let him form 3 new Dragon Marks.

Currently, there were 303 Dragon Marks in Jiang Chen’s Qi Sea, but he was still far from freaking through to the Late Heavenly Core realm. He would need a total of 400 Dragon Marks to break through to the Late Heavenly Core realm.

“Three Dragon Marks, this is just a fraction of what I need. Besides, the more I cultivate, the more energy I will need. Looks like in order for me to break through to the Late Heavenly Core realm, I will need to kill some Divine Core demon beasts.”
Jiang Chen sighed in his mind. Since the Misty Mountain was occupied by the Firethorn Savage, it wouldn’t allow other Divine Core demon beasts to reside here anyways.

The only good thing for Jiang Chen here was the Firethorn Savage, but it wasn’t an easy job to deal with it. Therefore, Jiang Chen was trying his best to kill some demon beasts in sector two in order to increase his combat strength.
Suddenly, two strong energies could be sensed from the outer area of Misty Mountain, and in the blink of an eye, two men blocked the path in front of Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
“Damn it, when is this going to end?!”

Big Yellow almost let fire come out from his nose. After provoking a big sect like the Green Sanctuary Sect, there was almost no way for them to remain low, trouble just kept coming at them with seemingly no end.
“A Divine Core warrior can quickly catch up with us.”
Jiang Chen sneered. He had actually been expecting this. The grievance between himself and the Green Sanctuary Sect had come to a stage where it would be difficult to resolve.
“Here they are!”
Xu Yun looked at Jiang Chen and Big Yellow with a cruel vision.

“I’ll handle that dog, the young man is yours. Don’t kill him, after capturing them both, we’ll torture them slowly. Those who dare challenge the dignity of our Green Sanctuary Sect and kill our disciples, we can’t let them die easily.”
“Alright, be careful Sect Elder, that dog is really strong. As for that young man, I can kill him with ease.”
Xu Yun said with a sneer.
“No matter how strong it is, it’s still just at the Heavenly Core realm. Watch how I capture it, we’ll have a dog meat feast later!”

The old man laughed out loudly. When Big Yellow heard him say dog meat feast, he immediately became enraged. He howled extremely loudly towards the skies, then in the next second, he turned into a golden light and pierced towards the old man.

Although the opponent was an Early Divine Core warrior, Jiang Chen didn’t worry about Big Yellow at all. The bloodline of a Divine Beast was too powerful, and although Big Yellow was only at the Late Heavenly Core realm, he would be able to fight an Early Divine Core warrior without too many problems.
“You’re seeking death!”
The old man unleashed his energy and punched out fiercely. The punch unleash a golden beam which shot towards Big Yellow with lightning speed.
Big Yellow didn’t show any fear, he simply rammed towards the attack with his head facing forwards.
Bang!

Energy ripples splashed everywhere. Big Yellow’s head had shattered the golden beam instantly. However, he was stopped by the attack as well. His opponent was after all a Divine Core warrior, it wouldn’t be an easy fight.
The first exchange ended up in a tie.
“What a strong head!”
The old man’s expression changed, but he didn’t really care too much about it. Massive energy was rolling all over his body, he was preparing to unleash an even more powerful attack.

On the other side, Xu Yun was walking towards Jiang Chen with a look of despise on his face. He had decided to take his sweet time in torturing this young man who only had an ordinary cultivation level.

sentences.text: Hearing what Jiang Chen said, Big Yellow’s face was instantly filled with an excited expression.
He leapt forwards with his strong body, and by using his metal-like dog head, he rammed towards the huge hand made from Wang Yu’s Yuan energy.
Bang!
Energies were boiling, the huge hand of Yuan energy couldn’t withstand Big Yellow’s head, it was destroyed just like a huge bubble.
“What?!”
Wang Yu exclaimed.
When Big Yellow attacked, only he could feel how powerful his opponent was.
The energy Big Yellow unleashed was way more powerful than Wang Yu’s.
He had underestimated the enemy this time!
Wang Yu knew he had underestimated his opponent, therefore, he dared not neglect any longer.
He immediately drew out a bright shining long sword and slashed out dozens of beams with his sword which weaved into a gigantic web.
With the sword in the center, he forcefully attacked Big Yellow.
“Kaka, your grandfather’s head is as hard as metal, it is not something your broken sword can harm!
You are too weak.”
Big Yellow was laughing out loudly.
Every everyone’s frightened gazes, he rammed towards the sword with his head.
His action had even made Jiang Chen feel shocked.
The sword carried by Wang Yu wasn’t an ordinary weapon, it was a razor sharp mid-ranked combat weapon.
Although Big Yellow’s head was really hard, Jiang Chen didn’t think it was hard enough to take on a mid-ranked combat weapon.
“Haha, you are just courting death!”
Even Wang Yu was laughing out loudly now.
In his mind, no matter how strong Big Yellow was, there was no way he could use his head to fight a mid-ranked combat weapon.
But too bad, Big Yellow had disappointed him.
Just before his head was about to collide with the sword, a mystical symbol suddenly appeared in between his eyes.
With the help of this symbol, Big Yellow’s head immediately covered by a golden light.
Clang!
What happened shocked everyone.
When Wang Yu’s mid-ranked combat weapon collided with Big Yellow’s head, the sword instantly broke.
“What?”
Wang Yu and all the other Green Sanctuary Sect disciples who came here to watch the fight shouted out in disbelief at the same time.
However, Big Yellow’s speed was too great, and he didn’t give Wang Yu any time to react.
With his head glowing in a golden light, he rammed into Wang Yu’s chest in the next second.
Bang!
Wang Yu became like a kite which had is string cut.
He was sent flying in a straight direction, and he broke a few huge trees before he was finally thrown onto the ground.
After colliding with Big Yellow’s head, this result was expected.
His head could even break a mid-ranked combat weapon, let alone a human being.
Wang Yu was coughing blood when was thrown onto the ground, there were even fragments of his internal organs mixed in with the blood.
His chest had completely caved in.
Plop!
Wang Yu fell flatly onto the ground, he was now dead.
Being killed by a dog’s head was just too annoying, he couldn’t die in peace at all.
Wa!
Everyone were shocked, all the disciples’ eyes widened, and their faces were filled with expressions of disbelief.
Wang Yu was a Late Heavenly Core inner circle disciple, and with his Late Heavenly Core cultivation base, he had quite a prominent position in the inner circle, and he hardly found any matches.
But still, he was today killed by a dog's head.
This was too brutal.
Ahhhh!!
The female disciple couldn’t stop herself from crying out in fear.
She thought Wang Yu could defeat the enemies, she had never expected this would happen.
“Let’s go.”
Jiang Chen said with an indifferent tone.
After that, he brought Big Yellow with him and walked deeper into Misty Mountain, soon after, he disappeared from the people’s sight.
“They didn’t kill me?
I’m still alive?”
The female disciple murmured to herself.
She was blanked out just now due to fear.
The enemy had killed three men in such a short amount of time, and she thought she would be killed as well, but she never expected he life would actually be spared.
She felt lucky she was able to survive from this.
All the outer circle disciple looked at each other with awful expressions.
“Who was that young man?
How does he have the audacity to kill Green Sanctuary Sect disciple in Misty Mountain?”
“That dog was too frightening, even senior disciple Wang Yu couldn’t withstand a single attack from it!
How can we continue our training with such a powerful demon lord here?”
“We have to inform the Sect Elders about this and have that man killed!”
“Don’t panic, it’s not long before the inner circle disciples’ training begins.
This incident will surely alarm our inner circle Divine Core Sect Elders, they will completely seal off the mountain and kill this man and dog!”
All the disciples were discussing the matter.
The Green Sanctuary Sect had occupied the Misty Mountain for such a long time, and never in history had something like this happened.
In Misty Mountain, unless they provoked the Firethorn Savage, no one would dare attack any disciple of the Green Sanctuary Sect.
Not long after that, another two figures came in from afar and landed in Misty Mountain.
An old man and a young man.
The young man was the inner circle disciple who went back to the Green Sanctuary Sect to inform the Sect Elders about what happened.
His name was Xu Yun, and similar to Wang Yu, he was a Late Heavenly Core warrior.
The Sect Elder who followed him here was an inner circle Sect Elder, a strong warrior at the Early Divine Core realm.
Both men immediately saw the dead bodies on the ground, and Wang Yu who had died a horrible death not far away.
“What?!
Even Wang Yu was killed?!
What a maniac, I will kill him with a thousand cuts!”
The old man instantly became enraged.
“Looks like that dog is really strong, even Wang Yu wasn’t its match.
Luckily I went back and invited a Divine Core Sect Elder and didn’t act recklessly like Wang Yu.
If I hadn’t, then I would have been dead like him now.”
Xu Yun felt lucky in his mind.
“How did Wang Yu die?”
Xu Yun turned to those Mortal Core outer circle disciples and asked.
“Senior disciple Xu, Wang Yu was killed by a dog!
It had a very strong head, and it broke senior disciple Wang’s mid-ranked combat weapon!
He was killed when the dog rammed its head into him!
As for that young man, he didn’t attack at all, but judging from his age, I don’t think he is that strong, he’s just being protected by that dog!”
An outer circle disciple described what happened just now.
When they recalled how brutal that dog was, all of these disciples felt chills down their spines.
“What?
That dog’s head is that powerful?”
Xu Yun was shocked.
“Where did that young man and dog go?”
The Divine Core Sect Elder asked.
“They went deeper into Misty Mountain not long ago.”
A disciple pointed towards the direction where Jiang Chen and Big Yellow went.
“Hmph!
What a maniac, how dare they challenge the Green Sanctuary Sect?
They have no idea what death means!
I will strike myself and kill them!”
The old man let out a cold snort.
In the blink of an eye, he started flying towards the deeper area of Misty Mountain.
Xu Yun moved at the same time and followed behind the old man.
With the help of a Divine Core Sect Elder, the dog would perish this time.
Xu Yun could help kill that young man in white.
The young man only had an ordinary cultivation base, and he had never attack before.
He also looked pretty young.
That was the only description Xu Yun had for Jiang Chen.
Therefore, he had all his attention focused on the dog, and didn’t really care too much about Jiang Chen.
However, what Xu Yun didn’t know was, misleading information like this would get himself killed.
Bang!
Within the second sector of Misty Mountain, a violent banging sound shook the place.
Jiang Chen had just killed a Late Heavenly Core demon lord and retrieved its demon soul.
With the help of the Dragon Transformation skill, the demon soul was absorbed by him in an instant.
With his current cultivation level, the demon soul of an Early or Mid Heavenly Core demon beast was useless.
But, the demon soul of a Late Heavenly Core demon lord could still let him form 3 new Dragon Marks.
Currently, there were 303 Dragon Marks in Jiang Chen’s Qi Sea, but he was still far from freaking through to the Late Heavenly Core realm.
He would need a total of 400 Dragon Marks to break through to the Late Heavenly Core realm.
“Three Dragon Marks, this is just a fraction of what I need.
Besides, the more I cultivate, the more energy I will need.
Looks like in order for me to break through to the Late Heavenly Core realm, I will need to kill some Divine Core demon beasts.”
Jiang Chen sighed in his mind.
Since the Misty Mountain was occupied by the Firethorn Savage, it wouldn’t allow other Divine Core demon beasts to reside here anyways.
The only good thing for Jiang Chen here was the Firethorn Savage, but it wasn’t an easy job to deal with it.
Therefore, Jiang Chen was trying his best to kill some demon beasts in sector two in order to increase his combat strength.
Suddenly, two strong energies could be sensed from the outer area of Misty Mountain, and in the blink of an eye, two men blocked the path in front of Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
“Damn it, when is this going to end?!”
Big Yellow almost let fire come out from his nose.
After provoking a big sect like the Green Sanctuary Sect, there was almost no way for them to remain low, trouble just kept coming at them with seemingly no end.
“A Divine Core warrior can quickly catch up with us.”
Jiang Chen sneered.
He had actually been expecting this.
The grievance between himself and the Green Sanctuary Sect had come to a stage where it would be difficult to resolve.
“Here they are!”
Xu Yun looked at Jiang Chen and Big Yellow with a cruel vision.
“I’ll handle that dog, the young man is yours.
Don’t kill him, after capturing them both, we’ll torture them slowly.
Those who dare challenge the dignity of our Green Sanctuary Sect and kill our disciples, we can’t let them die easily.”
“Alright, be careful Sect Elder, that dog is really strong.
As for that young man, I can kill him with ease.”

Watch how I capture it, we’ll have a dog meat feast later!”

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - It’s Getting Worse
paragraphs: Bang!

Energy waves unceasingly raged across the place, and the loud explosions showed no signs of stopping. Big Yellow and the old man were engaged in an intense fight, and no one seemed to win a hand over the other one. The old man was furious, he never thought a dog could be so strong. With a Late Heavenly Core cultivation base, it could actually fight him equally. This was really impossible, because between the Heavenly Core realm and Divine Core realm, there was a huge gap. This dog fighting against someone in a higher realm proved that it was a remarkable being.
On the other side, Xu Yun unleashed his powerful energy and locked his energy onto Jiang Chen, making sure he didn’t give Jiang Chen any chance to escape.

“Brat, you’re really brave! How dare you challenge the Green Sanctuary Sect, do you really think you can act lawlessly because you have the help of a demon lord? You’re just an idiot, have you seen that? Your dog is no match for a Divine Core warrior! Now, I’ll capture you and bring you back to torture you!”
Xu Yun spoke word by word, slowly. His face carried a look of despise, he was completely looking down on Jiang Chen.

It was normal for him to look down on Jiang Chen. After all, Big Yellow’s performance had been too strong, and Jiang Chen hadn’t even fought once sine the beginning. Therefore, all those people though Jiang Chen only had an ordinary cultivation base, and was only depending on the help of a demon lord. Xu Yun had the same mentality, and it was because of this mentality that he was stepping closer and close to an abyss.
“How do you know I’m only depending on a dog? What if my true strength is stronger than that dog?”
A tyrannical smile appeared on Jiang Chen’s face.
“Haha, prove it, kill me!”

Xu Yun was laughing out heartily upon hearing what Jiang Chen said. In his mind, Jiang Chen was no match for him. With a sway of his body, massive waves of energy flowed out from his body. Wave after wave of energy was shining brightly underneath the sunlight. The energy waves threw itself at Jiang Chen like a tidal wave.
“What a joker.”

Jiang Chen sneered. He simply stood there without moving a bit. With a palm covered in dragon scales, he simply waved his hand and instantly shattered all the energy waves unleashed by Xu Yun, as if he was just popping some bubbles.
After that, Jiang Chen moved like a lightning strike. In an instant, he appeared in front of Xu Yun. His cold blood red dragon claw had clenched tightly onto Xu Yun’s neck.

Xu Yun gasped. An extreme feeling of danger rose up from the bottom of his heart combined with a feeling of death being close to him. He could now only feel the dragon claw clenching his throat was extremely heavy, and he had given up all idea of resisting.
“No, please don’t kill me!”

Xu Yun was scared, and cold sweat had started dripping down from his forehead. An expert warrior knew what was going on when he was in a fight. When Jiang Chen attacked, Xu Yun had immediately regretted his decision. Jiang Chen was able to easily shatter his energy waves and control him, all in an instant. This proved that Jiang Chen’s combat strength was much higher than his. With his current combat strength, there was no way he could fight with Jiang Chen.

Right at this moment, Xu Yun couldn’t help but curse in his mind. Which bastard had told him that this young man only had an ordinary cultivation level? Was this fucking ordinary? He was even stronger than the dog, he really was extremely formidable.

Xu Yun was trembling. He used to be a smart person, but today he had made a mistake. If this young man really had an ordinary cultivation level, how could he heave a strong demon lord following him around?
But too bad, it was too late for Xu Yun to understand this, he could feel Jiang Chen’s killing intent right now.
“I, Jiang Chen never give anyone a second chance, and since you from the Green Sanctuary Sect has come and provoked me once again, then there is nothing much to say about it.
After saying that, Jiang Chen squeezed his palm and broke Xu Yun’s neck. The young genius of the Green Sanctuary Sect had died a tragic death.
“What?!”

On the other side, the old man who was fighting Big Yellow shouted out in alarm. He knew well about Xu Yun’s strength, and he had never expected that a young man whom none of them had paid much attention to could have killed him with just a single strike.
Where did these abnormal monsters come from, and how could they be so frightening?
“Kid, who the hell are you? Why do you want to go against the Green Sanctuary Sect?”
The old man stopped his attack and asked loudly.

“I never wanted to cross paths with the Green Sanctuary Sect, I just wanted to enter Misty Mountain. It was never my plan to fight with you guys, but you guys kept getting in my way and wanted to kill me. If that is the case, I won’t be polite with any of you. Old fool, since you are here, we won’t let you go back alive.”

Jiang Chen unleashed his energy. With a cruel decision, a golden light immediately appeared in his palm. In the next second, he pointed towards the old man with his finger, then he unleashed four huge golden fingers which forcefully pierced towards the old man.

Currently, Jiang Chen had managed to unleash the fourth finger if the Six Profound Solar Fingers. It was an extremely powerful attack, and with the support of all 303 Dragon Marks, ordinary Divine Core warriors wouldn’t be able to defend from the attack.

“What a strong young man, he only has a Mid Heavenly Core cultivation base, but he can be compared to Divine Core warriors! Where did this monster come from? I don’t know anyone in the Qian Province who matches his profile.”

The old man was struck with consternation. He had sensed Jiang Chen’s cultivation level when Jiang Chen attacked, but it had also sent a shock down the old man’s mind. Jiang Chen was so young, and with his cultivation level, he was able to unleash such powerful combat strength. This was simply the most abnormal monster he had ever met. As the inner circle Sect Elder of the Green Sanctuary Sect, he was well versed with all the strong young men in the Qian Province, but he had never heard of anyone like Jiang Chen.
He didn’t have much time to think. Jiang Chen’s attack had come closer to him, and he had to react with a counter attack.
Ha!
The old man shouted out loudly. He used his Yuan energy to form a bright spear. This was a powerful combat skill that could let him form any weapon that he wanted.
The spear continuously emanated a buzzing sound, and it looked like it was going to poke a hole through the thin air. In the next second, it pierced towards Jiang Chen’s Six Profound Solar Fingers.
Bang!

The massive energy ripples swept across the place and caused devastating damage to everything within a 10 mile circumference. Colorful ripples destroyed all trees and grass in the area, and turned the place into a ruined land. Many demon beasts were frightened by the violent explosions and started fleeing in every direction. The ripples from the collision of two Divine Core warriors’ attack could get them killed.
Tap tap tap...

Although the old man had destroyed the Six Profound Solar Fingers with his spear, he was forced back a dozen steps before he could stabilize his body. The Yuan energy spear in his hand had shattered as well. Both his arms were numb, and his palm was trembling. His qi and blood were being circulated in a messy way, which made him feel extremely awful.
“How can a Mid Heavenly Core warrior be so strong, is he still human?”
The old man was completely shocked. He had never seen any Heavenly Core warrior who could be so powerful, so strong that even with his combat strength, he couldn’t defeat him at all.

“What a young monster you are! However, since you have offended the Green Sanctuary Sect, you will still have to die. The real great warriors of the Green Sanctuary Sect will soon be here, and there will be no place for you to hide within Misty Mountain.”

The old man tried to threaten Jiang Chen. After saying that, he swayed his body and flew towards the exit of Misty Mountain. The old man was no idiot, after a brief fight, he knew he was no match for this young man in white. If he continued to fight here, he might end up like Xu Yun and die a horrible death, and that was not something he wanted.
“Trying to run? Too late!”

Jiang Chen portrayed an extreme intention to kill. In an instant, he unleashed the True Dragon Palm. A blood red dragon claw appeared high up above the skies, and like a jail, it captured to old man who was trying to flee.
“Break away!”
The old man shouted out loudly as he used all his strength. He tried to struggle and escape from Jiang Chen’s True Dragon Palm, but too bad, he had to face disappointment.
“The fuck?! This is an inherited combat skill of true dragons! Damn it, what kind of secret is this guy hiding?! How can he unleash a combat skill only true dragons can use?!”

Big Yellow’s eyes lit up, he was shocked by what he just saw. The last time Jiang Chen unleashed the True Dragon Palm was when he wreaked havoc in the Black Sect, and Big Yellow was not there, so he didn’t see what happened. That’s why he was so shocked right now. Since he was a Dragon Horse himself, he also possessed the bloodline of the dragon. He could easily tell if a combat skill was a true dragon combat skill or not.
“Still trying to escape from my True Dragon Palm? Stop dreaming now!”

Jiang Chen shouted out loudly as he controlled the dragon claw to forcefully squeeze. The old man instantly felt a massive force squeezing him from all directions, and cracking started sounding out from his body. All his Yuan energy was crushed by the dragon claw, it was like a few huge mountains were pressing him from all directions.
“Stop there!”

Right at this moment, another loud shout came from afar. After that, three figures flew towards them with great speed. They were three old men with powerful energies, and all of them were Divine Core warriors. There even was a Mid Divine Core warrior amongst them. With Jiang Chen’s current ability, there was no way he could defeat a Mid Divine Core warrior.

Judging from their clothes, all of them were Sect Elders of the Green Sanctuary Sect. When the old Mid Divine Core warrior saw that Jiang Chen had captured their own man, he immediately shouted out loudly.
“Hmph!”

Jiang Chen let out a cold snort. He simply ignored the shouting of the old Mid Divine Core warrior. In the next second, threads of golden flames shot out within the dragon claw, and in an instant, they turned into a sea of flames.
Ahhh!!

The Early Divine Core warrior instantly let out a shrill scream. Under the pressure of the True Dragon Palm, and the scorching heat from the True Dragon Flames, he finally couldn’t hold on any longer, and was burned into ashes in just the time of a few breaths.
“Damn it, this is even more powerful, this is the True Dragon Flames! This guy is going to defy the natural order!”
Big Yellow’s eyes lit up. It seemed like he was looking at a ghost when he saw Jiang Chen unleash his skill. This really was an eye opener.
“Bastard!”
The Mid Divine Core warrior shouted out with extreme fury. The guy really had the courage to kill a Divine Core Sect Elder in front of him, this was ridiculous!
The Green Sanctuary Sect was a big sect, and it was supported by all Divine Core warriors. The death of a single Divine Core warrior was an unimaginable loss for them.
“Kill this maniac now!”
Another Sect Elder became enraged as well. The Mid Divine Core warrior instantly unleashed an attack, he unleashed a bright curtain which covered towards Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
“Big Yellow, we’re no match for them, let’s go.”
Jiang Chen called upon Big Yellow and flew high up into the skies. Both man and dog flew towards the deeper area of Misty Mountain with lightning speed and disappeared from the scene in an instant.
“Chase them, if we don’t kill this guy, the reputation of the Green Sanctuary Sect will be greatly affected, and we’ll have a hard time remaining a big power house in the Qian Province!”
The Mid Divine Core warrior’s energy rose up into the skies. The three of them turned into three beams of light and chased after Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.

Although the old man had destroyed the Six Profound Solar Fingers with his spear, he was forced back a dozen steps before he could stabilize his body.
The Yuan energy spear in his hand had shattered as well.
Both his arms were numb, and his palm was trembling.
His qi and blood were being circulated in a messy way, which made him feel extremely awful.
“How can a Mid Heavenly Core warrior be so strong, is he still human?”
The old man was completely shocked.
He had never seen any Heavenly Core warrior who could be so powerful, so strong that even with his combat strength, he couldn’t defeat him at all.
“What a young monster you are!
However, since you have offended the Green Sanctuary Sect, you will still have to die.
The real great warriors of the Green Sanctuary Sect will soon be here, and there will be no place for you to hide within Misty Mountain.”
The old man tried to threaten Jiang Chen.
After saying that, he swayed his body and flew towards the exit of Misty Mountain.
The old man was no idiot, after a brief fight, he knew he was no match for this young man in white.
If he continued to fight here, he might end up like Xu Yun and die a horrible death, and that was not something he wanted.
“Trying to run?
Too late!”
Jiang Chen portrayed an extreme intention to kill.
In an instant, he unleashed the True Dragon Palm.
A blood red dragon claw appeared high up above the skies, and like a jail, it captured to old man who was trying to flee.
“Break away!”
The old man shouted out loudly as he used all his strength.
He tried to struggle and escape from Jiang Chen’s True Dragon Palm, but too bad, he had to face disappointment.
“The fuck?!
This is an inherited combat skill of true dragons!
Damn it, what kind of secret is this guy hiding?!
How can he unleash a combat skill only true dragons can use?!”
Big Yellow’s eyes lit up, he was shocked by what he just saw.
The last time Jiang Chen unleashed the True Dragon Palm was when he wreaked havoc in the Black Sect, and Big Yellow was not there, so he didn’t see what happened.
That’s why he was so shocked right now.
Since he was a Dragon Horse himself, he also possessed the bloodline of the dragon.
He could easily tell if a combat skill was a true dragon combat skill or not.
“Still trying to escape from my True Dragon Palm?
Stop dreaming now!”
Jiang Chen shouted out loudly as he controlled the dragon claw to forcefully squeeze.
The old man instantly felt a massive force squeezing him from all directions, and cracking started sounding out from his body.
All his Yuan energy was crushed by the dragon claw, it was like a few huge mountains were pressing him from all directions.
“Stop there!”
Right at this moment, another loud shout came from afar.
After that, three figures flew towards them with great speed.
They were three old men with powerful energies, and all of them were Divine Core warriors.
There even was a Mid Divine Core warrior amongst them.
With Jiang Chen’s current ability, there was no way he could defeat a Mid Divine Core warrior.
Judging from their clothes, all of them were Sect Elders of the Green Sanctuary Sect.
When the old Mid Divine Core warrior saw that Jiang Chen had captured their own man, he immediately shouted out loudly.
“Hmph!”
Jiang Chen let out a cold snort.
He simply ignored the shouting of the old Mid Divine Core warrior.
In the next second, threads of golden flames shot out within the dragon claw, and in an instant, they turned into a sea of flames.
Ahhh!!
The Early Divine Core warrior instantly let out a shrill scream.
Under the pressure of the True Dragon Palm, and the scorching heat from the True Dragon Flames, he finally couldn’t hold on any longer, and was burned into ashes in just the time of a few breaths.
“Damn it, this is even more powerful, this is the True Dragon Flames!
This guy is going to defy the natural order!”
Big Yellow’s eyes lit up.
It seemed like he was looking at a ghost when he saw Jiang Chen unleash his skill.
This really was an eye opener.
“Bastard!”
The Mid Divine Core warrior shouted out with extreme fury.
The guy really had the courage to kill a Divine Core Sect Elder in front of him, this was ridiculous!
The Green Sanctuary Sect was a big sect, and it was supported by all Divine Core warriors.
The death of a single Divine Core warrior was an unimaginable loss for them.
“Kill this maniac now!”
Another Sect Elder became enraged as well.
The Mid Divine Core warrior instantly unleashed an attack, he unleashed a bright curtain which covered towards Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
“Big Yellow, we’re no match for them, let’s go.”
Jiang Chen called upon Big Yellow and flew high up into the skies.
Both man and dog flew towards the deeper area of Misty Mountain with lightning speed and disappeared from the scene in an instant.
“Chase them, if we don’t kill this guy, the reputation of the Green Sanctuary Sect will be greatly affected, and we’ll have a hard time remaining a big power house in the Qian Province!”
The Mid Divine Core warrior’s energy rose up into the skies.
The three of them turned into three beams of light and chased after Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - The Powerful Firethorn Savage
paragraphs: The entire Misty Mountain had become restless. Sector two was filled with devastating energy all over, and the massive energy of Divine Core warriors was completely unleashed. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were crazily fleeing, and the three men were chasing closely behind them.

The Green Sanctuary Sect was the biggest sect in the Qian Province, and they sat high above all else. What happened today had never happened before. They had suffered a great loss, and if they couldn’t kill the young man and dog, the Green Sanctuary Sect’s reputation would be affected, and they wouldn’t be able to keep their number one position within the Qian Province any longer.
“Kaka, these three old fools are so clumsy! Fat chance they’ll be able to catch up with us!”

While flying with great speed, Big Yellow was laughing out heartily. Both he and Jiang Chen were both incredibly fast and strong. With their full speed, perhaps only a Late Divine Core warrior could catch up with them.

Big Yellow’s words were clearly heard by the three old men behind him. They almost threw up some blood. All of them were real Divine Core warrior, but this dog described them as clumsy. This was something they couldn’t bear at all.
“Sect Elder Liu, this dog is really wicked!”
An old man gnashed his teeth in anger.
“I’m going to skin that dog alive, then I’ll bake him into some roasted meat!”

The Mid Divine Core Sect Elder was also gnashing his teeth in anger. His name was Liu Hong, and he was one of the top men from the Green Sanctuary Sect. His status in the Green Sanctuary Sect was similar to Fan Zhong Tang’s position in the Black Sect.

“Where did this young man come from? He is an abnormal monster with incredibly powerful combat strength! He just killed an Early Divine Core warrior with his Mid Heavenly Core cultivation base, this is extremely rare!”
“Also, they are really fast, even we can’t catch up with them!”
Both Early Divine Core Sect Elders looked at each other with amazed expressions.
“I don’t care who he is, I have to kill him today no matter what! The dignity of the Green Sanctuary Sect can’t be challenged by any outsider! My sword, come out!”

Liu Hong shouted out loudly. A golden combat sword instantly appeared, and under his control, the sword expanded and became about 3 meters long. The trio all appeared close to the sword and started injecting their Yuan energy into it. In an instant, with the help of the sword, their speed increased by a lot. Soon after, the gap between them and Jiang Chen became smaller.
“Damn it, these old fools do have some decent abilities. Buddy, speed up, let’s ditch them!”

A pair of bright wings suddenly appeared on Big Yellow’s back, and his speed increased. On the other side, a pair of blood wings appeared on Jiang Chen’s back as well, and combined with the Dimensional Shift, Jiang Chen’s speed equalled Big Yellow’s. Once again, the distance between them and the three old men became larger.
“Damn it, hurry and chase up!”
Liu Hong was furious, he tried his best to catch up with them.
“Fuck, I feel like wanting to fight that old man now!”

Big Yellow said while feeling slightly depressed. But, he knew that with his and Jiang Chen’s current combat strength, there was no way they could defeat a Mid Divine Core warrior. Under such circumstances, the only option for them was to run.
“Hmph! Be patient, we have plenty of time in the future. Let’s ditch them for now.”
Jiang Chen snorted.
“Looks like it won’t be easy to ditch them, that old fool has locked down our energies.”
Big Yellow said.
“Let’s enter sector three, I’m sure they won’t have the courage to follow us since it’s the Firethorn Savage’s territory.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile.
“Don’t tell me you are going to find that Firethorn Savage right now. This is no different than committing suicide.”
Big Yellow said with a depressed expression.
“We can take this opportunity to check out the Firethorn Savage, then we’ll find a way to deal with it.”

Jiang Chen’s eyes were blinking brightly. In order to deal with the Firethorn Savage, they couldn’t use any force, they had to use their intelligence to handle it. But, since they had just come to Misty Mountain, and were being chased by the Green Sanctuary Sect, Jiang Chen just took this as an opportunity to enter the third sector to check out the Firethorn Savage’s situation.

All of them moved with extreme speed. Soon, they arrived at the border of the third sector. Jiang Chen could clearly sense that the natural energy here was much richer than the other places. The mist that was hovering around here was also thicker.
Without any hesitation, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow went straight into sector three.
Behind them, Liu Hong and the other two old men had also come to the border, but they stopped.
“That guy entered the third sector, what should we do now?”
One of the old men asked.

“We have an agreement with the Firethorn Savage, no men from the Green Sanctuary Sect can step into the third sector. Provoking the Firethorn Savage is no fun thing, and this guy has no idea how dangerous it is to enter the third sector. Once he provokes the Firethorn Savage, his life will end.”
Liu Hong sneered.
“Since he is certainly going to die in there, maybe we should just return now.”
Another Sect Elder said.

“No, we’ll wait here without giving that guy any chance to come out. The training of the outer circle disciples and the inner circle disciples will take another seven days. After seven days, we’ll leave with them, and if that guy still hasn’t come out by then, that means he has been killed by the Firethorn Savage and won’t come out again. Nobody can stay in sector three unharmed for more than seven days.”
Liu Hong said with a confident look.
“Alright, that young man will die. It’s so ridiculous that he has caused such a huge loss to the Green Sanctuary Sect.”
Another old man gnashed his in with anger.

“You guys go inform those disciples, ask them to guard all exits of Misty Mountain, have them release a signal immediately upon seeing that young man or the dog. They are now fish in a pond, and there is a powerful Firethorn Savage right ahead of them. I’ll see how they’ll deal with this.”
Liu Hong’s face carried an insidious expression, he was determined to kill Jiang Chen.
“Fine, we’ll go now.”
Both men left after saying that.
At the same time Jiang Chen and Big Yellow entered the third sector, the had descended from the skies and hidden all their energy and breathing, then they slowly walked deeper into the area.

“Big Yellow, don’t forget to hide your breath and energy, don’t fight any demon beasts along the way. We’ll have to avoid all fights until we find the base of the Firethorn Savage and check out the situation.”
Jiang Chen reminded.
“I understand.”
Big Yellow lowered his voice, but his face was filled with excitement. Big Yellow was unable to hold his excitement when doing something as big as this.

Their walking speed wasn’t slow, and they soon came to the center of the third sector. Due to them hiding their energy and breathing, they didn’t alert any demon beasts along the way. Besides, there weren’t many demon beasts residing in the third sector. With the king of Misty Mountain, the Firethorn Savage residing here, not many demon beasts dared stay close in the third sector.
Along the way, Jiang Chen had seen a lot of strange flowers and weird plants. There were even some rare herbs. He simply picked them up and put them into his storage ring.

“The Misty Mountain really is a rich land, no wonder the Green Sanctuary Sect doesn’t want to give it up, and even went so far to make an agreement with the Firethorn Savage. Big Yellow, use your innate ability and try to sense if there are any treasures nearby.”
Jiang Chen said as he looked at Big Yellow.
“Treasure your big head! You think that treasure is something that you can find anywhere?”
Big Yellow gazed at Jiang Chen helplessly. If there were any treasure nearby, Big Yellow would be able to sense it in an instant.

While walking in a narrow valley, Jiang Chen’s eyes suddenly lit up. He saw within a crack not far away, there was a purple colored orchid growing. Under the sunlight’s reflection, it was shining in a purple glow.
“A Violet Ying Orchid, haha, I never expected there would be a Violet Ying Orchid here! What a lucky day!”
Jiang Chen was excited. Although this purple colored flower was only the size of his palm, it had blossomed with nine petals and had a thick root. Obviously, it had reached its matured state.
“This Violet Ying Orchid is one of the main ingredients for the Profound Six Solar Pill! I couldn’t find it in the Black Sect, and I never expected to find it here.”

Without saying much more, Jiang Chen picked the flower up. In his memory, a total of 49 herbs were required to concoct the Profound Six Solar Pill- Guo Shan basically had all of them except for this Violet Ying Orchid.
“I never thought you would be such a lucky bastard!”
Big Yellow turned his nose up towards Jiang Chen.
“Go away, this is my lucky day. As a dog, you wouldn’t know anything about this.”
Jiang Chen slapped Big Yellow’s head, causing it to produce a loud sound resembling metals colliding.
“Ruff ruff ruff!! I am not a dog!”
Big Yellow bared his teeth.
“Damned dog, lower your voice, don’t alert the Firethorn Savage, damn it.”
Jiang Chen gazed at Big Yellow. They were in the deepest area of the third sector, and they needed to act carefully as to not attract the Firethorn Savage’s attention.
The man and dog continued their journey. Suddenly, a violent roar sounded out not far away from them.
Graaa...
The roar was extremely loud and deep, and it carried the power of the king of all beasts. With its roar, it could make all beasts in the mountain submit to it.
“It’s the Firethorn Savage.”
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow exclaimed.
“The roar came from in front of us. Just from the sound alone I can tell how frightening this Firethorn Savage is. Let’s go over and check it out. Remember, don’t make a noise.”
Jiang Chen said.

In front of them there was a small hill, and the Firethorn Savage’s roar came from there. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow carefully climbed up to the middle of the hill without making any noise, then they both extended their heads upwards. In an instant, they saw a massive object lying not too far away from them.
In the middle of the hill there was a neat, small field. Behind it there was a huge cave. Right now, a huge and majestic demon beast lying in the center of the field.
The beast was over 6 meters tall even when it was lying on the floor. His body was fully covered with golden scale, and underneath the sunlight’s shine, it was reflecting a bright glow.

This was the Firethorn Savage. It had an ugly face with two obviously sharp fangs in its mouth. Right now, the Firethorn Savage was lying motionlessly on the floor with both its eyes shut. It seemed like it was in the middle of enjoying its sun bath.

But Jiang Chen knew that this Firethorn Savage was actually in the middle of cultivation. It was absorbing the pure Yang energy that was being emitted from the sun. This was the innate ability of the Firethorn Savage.

Ordinary demon beasts would be able to transform into human form when they broke through to the Heavenly Core realm, but it would be more difficult for the demon beasts that were above the average. Taking the Firethorn Savage as an example, its cultivation level had reached the peak of the Mid Divine Core realm, but it was still unable to transform into human form. It probably needed to break through to the Combat Soul realm, or perhaps the Demon King realm before being able to transform.

As for a Divine Beast such as Big Yellow, his transformation would be even harder. He might need to break through to the Demon Saint realm before he could have the possibility of transforming into human form. The Demon Saint realm was equal to the humans’ Saint realm.

The Firethorn Savage was in his cultivation mode, and he had no idea that that there were two uninvited guests watching him from close by. Right at this moment, if he scanned the area with its Divine Sense, he would discover Jiang Chen and Big Yellow immediately. However, this Firethorn Savage would never expect that anyone would dare intrude the third sector and come so close to it.

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - Golden Egg
paragraphs: Zzz...

The Firethorn Savage looked like it had fallen asleep as it snored. Every time it breathed, some golden colored bubbles would burst out from its nose together with a strong energy. If there was some dust in front of it, each breath would be able to produce a sandstorm.
“Damn it, a Mid Divine Core Firethorn Savage is really powerful. If I could break through to the Divine Core realm, I would easily be able to kill him!”
Big Yellow spoke to Jiang Chen through his Divine Sense. Although the Firethorn Savage’s bloodline was noble, if it was compared to a Dragon Horse’s bloodline, it was still far behind.

“What an overbearing Firethorn Savage! Even the breath is enough to frighten most people! I think that even Daoist Black would be unable to defeat it. If I could absorb this Firethorn Savage’s demon soul, I would be able to break through to the Late Heavenly Core realm, and I would be one step closer to the Divine Core realm! A Firethorn Savage’s demon soul could help me form at least another 300 Dragon Marks!”
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up. Too bad, it was extremely hard to kill this Firethorn Savage. This big guy was just too strong.
“Buddy, are you going to neglect Little Yu’s recovery?”
Big Yellow gazed at Jiang Chen angrily.

“I’m just joking. There are so many Divine Core demon beasts out there, and once I enter Inferno Hello, I won’t have to worry about a lack of demon beasts. The Firethorn Savage’s demon soul will be used to concoct the Profound Six Solar Pill which will save Little Yu.”
Jiang Chen explained to Big Yellow. Although he was slavering the Firethorn Savage’s demon soul, he knew Yan Chen Yu needed this demon soul more than him right now.
“So what should we do now? Don’t tell me we are just going to watch it from here all day?”
Big Yellow was getting impatient.
“What do you think? Do you want to go up there and try fighting it yourself?”
Jiang Chen had a smile on his face.
“Get lost!”
Big Yellow moved his body away from Jiang Chen.

“This Firethorn Savage is too strong, there is no way we can defeat him face to face. We need to find some clever way. Let’s hide our breath and wait here first. This Firethorn Savage has been living in the Misty Mountain for a long time, it must have its own routine. Let’s keep an eye on its routine for now.”
Jiang Chen said.

A man and a dog held their breath as they watched the Firethorn Savage silently sleeping. Big Yellow yawned, and with a depressed expression he said, “Damn it, what is this all about?! Both of you are just staying here and watching a demon beast sleeping, it’s making your father sleepy now!”
Jiang Chen gazed at Big Yellow, he too felt somewhat depressed. He was once the greatest Saint in the world, but now he was hiding and watching a demon beast sleeping. This was ridiculous.

An hour later, the sun had risen to the top of their heads. It was around noon now, it was also the time when the pure Yang energy was the strongest. The sleeping Firethorn Savage suddenly opened its eyes, and it looked really frightening.

The Firethorn Savage let out a loud roar. After that, it’s massive and majestic body slowly stood up from the ground. The 6 meter tall body had become a 15 meter tall body, and it had four thick and strong legs fully covered with golden scales that looked like four huge pillars.
It was so huge, the Firethorn Savage was like a small sized golden hill. Its body was shining so brightly that no one could stare directly at it.
The Firethorn Savage had awakened. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow strengthened their spirits at the same time. They didn’t dare make a single noise, and they held their breaths tightly.

This Firethorn Savage obviously didn’t expect someone would intrude its territory. Therefore, it didn’t pay any attention to the surround area. This was not because its senses were weak, it was because Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were extremely good at hiding. If it was someone else, they would have probably been discovered by the Firethorn Savage.
Roar!

The Firethorn Savage suddenly let out another loud roar that sounded out through the woods. With a sway, its massive body jumped into the skies and dashed towards another direction. It soon disappeared from Jiang Chen and Big Yellow’s sight.
“Gone like that?”
Big Yellow was startled.
“It’s now noon, it’s the time when the pure Yang energy is at tits richest, this Firethorn Savage should have continued its cultivation, why did it choose to leave at this hour?”
Jiang Chen furrowed his brows and felt puzzled.
“Whatever, let’s take this opportunity to check out its cave.”
Big Yellow jumped up and prepared to walk towards the cave, but Jiang Chen pulled him back.
“Buddy, why are you pulling me?”
Big Yellow bared his teeth.
“Be careful, if that Firethorn Savage comes back, we’ll be doomed.”
Jiang Chen pulled Big Yellow back to their hiding spot.
“Let’s spend some more time monitoring the Firethorn Savage’s routine, then we’ll discuss what to do next.”

Jiang Chen wanted to cover all bases. Their opponent was so powerful, there was no way they could fight it with force alone, they had to understand all of its routines before thinking about a way to deal with it.

The wait lasted for half an hour, and Big Yellow also nagged continuously for half an hour. He kept complaining that Jiang Chen was a coward. Half an hour was more than enough for him to wreak havoc in Firethorn Savage’s cave.
But Jiang Chen just remained calm. He wouldn’t act recklessly before figuring out the Firethorn Savage’s routine.
Swoosh...

Right at this moment, the Firethorn Savage came back from afar. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow could clearly see that his mouth was open when it flew back. Within his mouth, something was shining brightly. It was a ball of water.
Clop!
The Firethorn Savage landed on the field and shook the entire hill. After that, he walked back into the cave and spent another half hour in there.
Half an hour later, the Firethorn Savage came out from the cave and laid down on the same spot, then it continued slumbering.
“It’s sleeping again.”
Big Yellow rolled his eyes. Finally, he had found someone who could sleep more than him.
“Be patient, let’s continue waiting.”
Jiang Chen kept comforting Big Yellow. This dog seriously lacked patience.

The Firethorn Savage really knew how to sleep well. It only woke up around noon the next day, and once again, at this hour of the day, the Firethorn Savage flew away from the field in the same direction as he previously went.
“It’s gone, again.”
Big Yellow widened his eyes.
“So this is its routine. Yesterday, when the Firethorn Savage came back, I think there was something in its mouth. You saw that too, right?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“Yea, there really was something in its mouth.”
Big Yellow nodded his head.
“Come, let’s follow and check where the hell this Firethorn Savage went.”

After saying that, Jiang Chen stood up and walked towards the direction where the Firethorn Savage went. He and Big Yellow didn’t fly tis time, they just sprinted on the ground. Flying would cause a slight disturbance with the natural Yuan energy, and this would make the Firethorn Savage discover their existence.

Tens of miles away from the Firethorn Savage’s cave there was a valley. Right in the middle of this valley there was a pond, and at the center of the pond there was a huge floating rock. The rock was hollow, and right now, the Firethorn Savage was laying in the with its head inside the hollow rock.

Jiang Chen and Big Yellow both saw some crystal clear liquid within thee rock. The liquid was so clear that it reflected the sunlight like a crystal. They knew what the liquid was, it was the rare Energy Spring Water, the same that they had found in the Water Curtain Cave. It was a surprise for them that even this place had Energy Spring Water.
Right now, the Firethorn Savage had soaked its red tongue into the Energy Spring Water. It wasn’t drinking the water, it had just put its tongue into it without moving.
“What is it doing now?”
Big Yellow asked with a puzzled expression.
“He is releasing his own life-force essence... why is the Firethorn Savage releasing its life-force essence into the Energy Spring Water?”

Jiang Chen furrowed his brows. The Firethorn Savage was using the time where the pure Yang energy was the richest to release its life-force essence into the Energy Spring Water, and this behavior really puzzled Jiang Chen. If it was here to drink the Energy Spring Water, that would be somewhat understandable. This water was after all a rare treasure. Human or demon beast, they all had a huge demand for it.

But not only did this Firethorn Savage not drink the Energy Spring Water, it was actually releasing its life-force essence. This didn’t bring it anything good, it would just cause it a huge consumption.

Half an hour later, the Firethorn Savage opened its mouth and swallowed the Energy Spring Water that had merged with its life-force essence. After that, it jumped up into the skies and flew back to where it came from with great speed, causing some huge waves to appear in the pond.
“So it was this Energy Spring Water that was in its mouth yesterday.”
Big Yellow said.
“What else could it be?”
Jiang Chen rolled his eyes.
“Kaka, there is so much Energy Spring Water here! Don’t waste it, let I take it all away!”
Big Yellow was laughing and was filled with excitement.

“No way! If you take the Energy Spring Water, it will alert the Firethorn Savage. If I am not mistaken, the Firethorn Savage will come here again tomorrow. If it finds out the Energy Spring Water is gone, it will surely become enraged.”
Jiang Chen kept pulling Big Yellow back.

When they returned to their hiding spot, they saw the Firethorn Savage walking out from the cave once again. The Energy Spring Water in its mouth had disappeared, but the Energy Spring Water’s energy ripples didn’t exist in its body. It was the opposite, it actually looked tired after losing some of its life-force essence, and it soon lied back down onto the field and begun sleeping.
During the next two days, the Firethorn Savage repeated its routine. It flied to the pond around noon, got some Energy Spring Water, went into the cave, then went to sleep.
“This Firethorn Savage doesn’t drink the Energy Spring Water itself, there must be something important in the cave that is cares so much about. We’ll enter the cave tomorrow at noon.”

Jiang Chen made up his mind. After spending three days, he had finally figured out the Firethorn Savage’s routing. It was obvious that there was something important that this Firethorn Savage cared extremely much about in the cave. Therefore, it might be the key point for Jiang Chen to deal with this Firethorn Savage.

Around noon, the next day. Just like before, the Firethorn Savage went to the pond once again. After it left the place, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow instantly jumped up and went into the cave with lightning speed. They knew that it would take the Firethorn Savage half an hour before returning, so they had more than enough time.

The Firethorn Savage’s cave was really huge, but simple. Right in the middle of the cave there was a small pond, and in the center of the pond there was a golden egg the size of a human head. The head was glowing in a golden light.

A golden aura was hovering around the golden egg, and there were countless golden symbols swirling around the egg. A rich sense of life-force was coming out from, and underneath the golden egg there was the Energy Spring Water that contained the Firethorn Savage’s life-force essence.
“This is the Firethorn Savage’s egg, its baby. No wonder the Firethorn Savage wanted to merge the Energy Spring Water with its life-force essence.”
Jiang Chen finally understood why this Firethorn Savage kept wasting its life-force essence.
