chapters.title: Chapter 187 - Astonishing Accomplishment
paragraphs: The scorching flames were dancing around happily. The air seemed to be on the verge of burning out. Even though Jiang Chen was controlling the flames, as well as covering the flames with a certain amount of his Yuan energy, the True Dragon Flame was too mighty. It had raised the temperature of the furnace room in an instant, causing a blazing airflow to float around in the furnace room.

Jiang Chen had a calm expression. His black hair was fluttering backwards, and his eyes were brimming with vigor like a pair of dark gemstones. With all his focus, he kept staring at the sea of flames in front of him. Within the flames, all 48 herbs were floating in different positions, and were being burned with different temperatures that suited them individually.

If Guo Shan was here, even though he already knew about Jiang Chen’s ability, he would be laying on the floor due to extreme shock. Purifying 48 herbs compared to 5 herbs simultaneously were two completely different things. This was because each herb had its own smelting point in purification, only when the heat reached a certain point would it be purified and the impurities would disappear. If the temperature wasn’t high enough, then the impurities wouldn’t be completely burnt off, and if the temperature was too high, then it would burn some of the herb’s essence.

Therefore, in the purification process, it required the alchemist to have a very precise control of the flame. The alchemist needed to focus with all his attention, and use his soul energy to sense the smelting point of each herb, and control the temperature of the flame to that point. Only then would he be able to get rid of all impurities while keeping all of the essence.

There are no doubts about this being a very difficult step in alchemy. Therefore, when ordinary alchemist concocted pills, they would use a furnace to help control the temperature of the flame. Besides, since each herb had its own smelting point, the alchemist would need to purify them one at a time, or purify herbs with the same smelting point at the same time. If two herbs with different smelting points were purified at the same time, it would usually result in impurities remaining or essence being burned off, which then makes the pill low quality.

Even the alchemists with rich experience might at most purify a few herbs together at once. The fact that Jiang Chen is able to purify dozens of herbs together at once was simply astounding. Only the renowned alchemists had the courage to do so, and none of them would be able to do it so leisurely.

However, this was Jiang Chen, he was once a mighty Saint rank alchemist. Along with the Great Soul Derivation skill that gives him an excellent perception and precise control, he also had the True Dragon Flames. He truly possesses a godly prowess when it came to concocting pills.

Purifying dozens of herbs at the same time was not something easily accomplished. Jiang Chen needed to find over 40 smelting points in these herbs and burn them at the same time; this step had taken him nearly three hours.
“It took me nearly three hours. If I was in my prime, I would be able to do it in minutes.”

Jiang Chen shook his head. If what he said was heard by Guo Shan, or any other alchemist, they might have thrown up all their blood and try to attack Jiang Chen. His words dealt a huge blow to all alchemists. His words could make every single alchemist in this world feel ashamed.

Put aside other alchemists and just use Guo Shan as an example; if he wanted to purify all 48 herbs, it might have taken him at least 4-5 days. As for Firethorn Savage’s demon soul, he might need even longer. And then there was the last step which was merging all the ingredients. Without at least half a month, it was simply impossible for him to concoct the Profound Six Solar Pill.
“Next, I’ll need to refine Firethorn Savage’s demon soul. I’ll melt it down to liquid, then I’ll merge everything together and produce the pill.”

Jiang Chen thought to himself. With the control of his Yuan energy, 48 purified herb essences glowed colorfully. All of them looked like droplets of crystal as they floated at one corner within the flame.

Jiang Chen flipped his palm and retrieved the golden colored Firethorn Savage’s demon soul from his storage ring, then he threw the fist-sized demon soul into the sea of flames. His True Dragon Flame transformed into dozens of fiery dragons which immediately surrounded the demon soul.
HA!
Jiang Chen let out a shout, then he adjusted the True Dragon Flame’s temperature to its maximum, then he begun to burn Firethorn Savage’s demon soul.

Firethorn Savage’s demon soul contained a massive amount of energy essence, and it couldn’t be wasted. Aside from that, it also contained pure yang energy within, which was the source of Firethorn Savage’s strength.

Actually, the demon soul only contained the demon’s essence, so there was no need for it to be purified at all. What Jiang Chen was doing now was melting it down to liquid form so that he could merge it with the other ingredients.

Melting down Firethorn Savage’s demon soul was some extremely difficult. Not only was it difficult because of its durability, Jiang Chen also need to make sure that the source energy contained within was not wasted, and that would require him to be extra careful while melting it. He couldn’t afford to make a single mistake.

Outside the furnace room, Guo Shan and Big Yellow were sitting face to face next to a stone table. This time, Guo Shan was generous enough to serve the best wine he had brewed with some herbs to Big Yellow. In his mind, Jiang Chen would need some days to concoct the pill this time, so he could use that time for find out more about what happened during their trip to Misty Mountain from Big Yellow.

“Old man Guo Shan, you finally show some hospitality and serve this master dog with some fine wine, not bad. After following this master dog for some time, you have learnt from me and found out how to do things correctly.”
Big Yellow held a jade wine glass with his paws. He drank the fine wine as he held his head up high.

“That’s enough, I can’t even shut your mouth with this fine wine. I think the day where you stop being so narcissistic is the day when the sun rises from the west! Hurry, tell daddy all the detail about your trip to Misty Mountain!”
Guo Shan immediately stopped Big Yellow from talking further. When this dog’s narcissistic side is awakened, the heavens would walk and the ground would fly. He was one mighty bragger.

When Guo Shan mentioned Misty Mountain, Big Yellow immediately became excited. He began talking nonstop, and his saliva splashed everywhere, including Guo Shan’s face and head. He was confused about whether or not it was Big Yellow’s saliva or some wine.

Guo Shan furrowed his brows, he began feeling regret about his decision to chat with Big Yellow. If it wasn’t for him really wanting to know the details about what happened in Misty Mountain, he might have flipped the table and walked away, without ever sitting down together with Big Yellow to drink again.

Within the furnace room, it took Jiang Chen an entire day before he finally melted down Firethorn Savage’s demon soul. He had some sweat dripping down from his forehead. If it was any other alchemist, he might already be laying on the floor in exhaustion.
“Now, the next step, merging all ingredients and producing the pill, the most crucial step.”
Jiang Chen’s expression changed into a serious one; even he dared not show any neglect right now. Finally, Jiang Chen begun the last step of the process; merging.
Qian Province, Green Sanctuary Sect.
Liu Hong and the other Sect Elders returned from the Qi Province, and they were now meeting with Qing Styx.
“How was it? Did you guys find out anything?”
Qing Styx’s combat strength had almost fully recovered. He opened his eyes and looked at Liu Hong and the other two Sect Elders.
“Sect Chief, we’ve found something, that’s why we returned to report it to you. We’ll wait for Sect Chief’s orders.”
Liu Hong said.
“Why? Did that young guy have some sort of troublesome background?”

Qing Styx furrowed his brows. With Liu Hong’s temper, he didn’t kill Jiang Chen straightaway, but instead returned to the Green Sanctuary Sect. This proved that the young man had a troublesome background. At least, the background was not something Liu Hong could afford to offend.

“That’s right, that Jiang Chen isn’t from the Qian Province, he is from the Qi Province, and he is very famous within the Qi Province. When we arrived in the Qi Province, every single person we asked knew his name.”

Li Hong said with mixed feelings. The trip to the Qi Province was to find out about Jiang Chen had gone unexpectedly smooth. He had thought he would need to go through the entire Qi Province to find Jiang Chen, he had never expected that Jiang Chen was so famous that every single person he asked knew about him.

Indeed, Jiang Chen was a man whom everyone in the Qi Province knew about. Besides, the place where Liu Hong had gone was the Yellowstone area, where Jiang Chen was worshipped like an immortal, and even a three year old kid idolized him.
“Tell me about it.”
Qing Styx said.

“The young man is a disciple of the Black Sect, and he made his debut in the Qi Province competition. He also has a fight agreement with the Burning Sky Pavilion’s Nan Bei Chao in one year. He recently became famous in the Qi Province after killing all Blood Devils and Lord Blood Moon. He even killed Liang Xiao from the Heavenly Sword Sect. I heard that this man’s cultivation speed is extremely fast, and Daoist Black favors him; that’s why we didn’t strike, and instead came back to report. We need Sect Chief to decide on this matter.”
Liu Hong told Qing Styx about everything he had learned in the Qi Province.

“Nan Bei Chao is a rare peerless genius, and I think the Martial Saint Dynasty has already noticed him. There’s no doubt he is going to join them in the future. This Jiang Chen is really brave to make a one-year fight agreement with him.”
Qing Styx nodded his head. He wasn’t too surprised about Jiang Chen, a genius like him was surely known by many.
“Sect Chief, since Jiang Chen is from the Black Sect, what should we do now?”

Liu Hong asked. The overall strength of the Black Sect was similar to the Green Sanctuary Sect. Besides, if the Green Sanctuary Sect really sent someone to kill Jiang Chen in the Qi Province, there wouldn’t be many advantages for them, as the place wasn’t their territory.

“Let’s wait, we can’t afford to offend the Black Sect right now. The Qi Province is after all not our territory. Just let that young man off for now. I’ll fully recover tomorrow, then I’ll proceed to Misty Mountain and kill that Firethorn Savage. If I can obtain his demon soul, I’ll be able to break through to the Combat Soul realm. When that time comes, the Black Sect will be nothing.

Qing Styx said. However, he did not expect that what awaited him tomorrow when he arrived at Misty Mountain was just a dead Firethorn Savage, and his decision of letting Jiang Chen off for now would be unreal.
“Alright, we’ll follow Sect Chief’s orders.”

Liu Hong cupped his fist towards Qing Styx. Although he hates Jiang Chen to the maximum, he also understood that going to the Black Sect to kill Jiang Chen was basically impossible. Therefore, what he could do now was just follow Qing Styx’s orders.
Black Sect, Guo Shan’s mountain peak!
Late evening, energy ripples suddenly came out from the furnace room which had been quiet for an entire day. Guo Shan and Big Yellow raised their brows at the same time.
“These ripples... Don’t tell me he successfully concocted the pill?”

Guo Shan said with a hint of disbelief. Only one and a half day had passed, and if Jiang Chen had really concocted the Profound Six Solar Pill in one and a half days, that would be a really astonishing accomplishment.
Crack...
The door of the furnace room was pushed open, and Jiang Chen who was wearing white clothes walked out from the room with a bright smile on his face, and a golden colored pill floating in his palm.

If it was any other alchemist, he might already be laying on the floor in exhaustion.
“Now, the next step, merging all ingredients and producing the pill, the most crucial step.”
Jiang Chen’s expression changed into a serious one; even he dared not show any neglect right now.
Finally, Jiang Chen begun the last step of the process; merging.
Qian Province, Green Sanctuary Sect.
Liu Hong and the other Sect Elders returned from the Qi Province, and they were now meeting with Qing Styx.
“How was it?
Did you guys find out anything?”
Qing Styx’s combat strength had almost fully recovered.
He opened his eyes and looked at Liu Hong and the other two Sect Elders.
“Sect Chief, we’ve found something, that’s why we returned to report it to you.
We’ll wait for Sect Chief’s orders.”
Liu Hong said.
“Why?
Did that young guy have some sort of troublesome background?”
Qing Styx furrowed his brows.
With Liu Hong’s temper, he didn’t kill Jiang Chen straightaway, but instead returned to the Green Sanctuary Sect.
This proved that the young man had a troublesome background.
At least, the background was not something Liu Hong could afford to offend.
“That’s right, that Jiang Chen isn’t from the Qian Province, he is from the Qi Province, and he is very famous within the Qi Province.
When we arrived in the Qi Province, every single person we asked knew his name.”
Li Hong said with mixed feelings.
The trip to the Qi Province was to find out about Jiang Chen had gone unexpectedly smooth.
He had thought he would need to go through the entire Qi Province to find Jiang Chen, he had never expected that Jiang Chen was so famous that every single person he asked knew about him.
Indeed, Jiang Chen was a man whom everyone in the Qi Province knew about.
Besides, the place where Liu Hong had gone was the Yellowstone area, where Jiang Chen was worshipped like an immortal, and even a three year old kid idolized him.
“Tell me about it.”
Qing Styx said.
“The young man is a disciple of the Black Sect, and he made his debut in the Qi Province competition.
He also has a fight agreement with the Burning Sky Pavilion’s Nan Bei Chao in one year.
He recently became famous in the Qi Province after killing all Blood Devils and Lord Blood Moon.
He even killed Liang Xiao from the Heavenly Sword Sect.
I heard that this man’s cultivation speed is extremely fast, and Daoist Black favors him; that’s why we didn’t strike, and instead came back to report.
We need Sect Chief to decide on this matter.”
Liu Hong told Qing Styx about everything he had learned in the Qi Province.
“Nan Bei Chao is a rare peerless genius, and I think the Martial Saint Dynasty has already noticed him.
There’s no doubt he is going to join them in the future.
This Jiang Chen is really brave to make a one-year fight agreement with him.”
Qing Styx nodded his head.
He wasn’t too surprised about Jiang Chen, a genius like him was surely known by many.
“Sect Chief, since Jiang Chen is from the Black Sect, what should we do now?”
Liu Hong asked.
The overall strength of the Black Sect was similar to the Green Sanctuary Sect.
Besides, if the Green Sanctuary Sect really sent someone to kill Jiang Chen in the Qi Province, there wouldn’t be many advantages for them, as the place wasn’t their territory.
“Let’s wait, we can’t afford to offend the Black Sect right now.
The Qi Province is after all not our territory.
Just let that young man off for now.
I’ll fully recover tomorrow, then I’ll proceed to Misty Mountain and kill that Firethorn Savage.
If I can obtain his demon soul, I’ll be able to break through to the Combat Soul realm.
When that time comes, the Black Sect will be nothing.
Qing Styx said.
However, he did not expect that what awaited him tomorrow when he arrived at Misty Mountain was just a dead Firethorn Savage, and his decision of letting Jiang Chen off for now would be unreal.
“Alright, we’ll follow Sect Chief’s orders.”
Liu Hong cupped his fist towards Qing Styx.
Although he hates Jiang Chen to the maximum, he also understood that going to the Black Sect to kill Jiang Chen was basically impossible.
Therefore, what he could do now was just follow Qing Styx’s orders.
Black Sect, Guo Shan’s mountain peak!
Late evening, energy ripples suddenly came out from the furnace room which had been quiet for an entire day.
Guo Shan and Big Yellow raised their brows at the same time.
“These ripples...
Don’t tell me he successfully concocted the pill?”
Guo Shan said with a hint of disbelief.
Only one and a half day had passed, and if Jiang Chen had really concocted the Profound Six Solar Pill in one and a half days, that would be a really astonishing accomplishment.
Crack...
The door of the furnace room was pushed open, and Jiang Chen who was wearing white clothes walked out from the room with a bright smile on his face, and a golden colored pill floating in his palm.

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - Martial Palace
paragraphs: Guo Shan immediately fixed his gaze on the pill floating in Jiang Chen’s palm. He could sense the pure energy radiating from the pill, and all the mystical symbols that covered the pill gave it a sense of divinity.
The energy that overflowed from the pill would make anyone who breathed it in feel refreshed, and give him an unparalleled comfortable feeling.
Two bright beams shout out from Big Yellow’s eyes, he kept staring at the pill as he drooled nonstop.
“Damn it, this pill looks so delicious! It would be best if daddy could take it as an appetizer with this wine!”
Big Yellow said in a heartless manner. But, before he could finish his words, Jiang Chen’s foot slammed into his face, leaving a huge footmark on it.
“Damned dog, don’t even think about it! You’re just looking for a hard beating!”
Jiang Chen glared at Big Yellow. Big Yellow knew he was in the wrong, thus, for the first time, he didn’t retort.

“48 herbs combined with Firethorn Savage’s demon soul and Six Solar Holy Water. Finally, I’ve successfully concocted the Profound Six Solar Pill. With this pill, Little Yu will be able to sustain her life-energy.”

Jiang Chen said. He had prepared the Six Solar Holy Water before he started concocting the pill. Jiang Chen cultivated the Six Solar Energies, which allowed him to absorb the pure Yang energy from the natural environment and turn it into Six Solar Holy Water, and this was one of the ingredients that couldn’t be replaced.
“Oh, younger brother...”
Guo Shan unexpectedly started crying out. Tears came rolling, and he couldn’t help but cry his lungs out.

Jiang Chen was confused by Guo Shan’s tears. He had obtained Firethorn Savage’s demon soul and successfully concocted the Profound Six Solar Pill, so Guo Shan should supposedly be happy. Even if he wasn’t happy at all, why would he be crying?
“Older brother Guo, what happened to you? Who bullied you? Was it Big Yellow? Let me bully him back!”
Jiang Chen said seriously, but it actually made Guo Shan cry even louder.
“Damn it, it is you who made him cry, what does this have to do with me? This old guy is crying because you dealt him a heavy blow!”
Big Yellow jumped in and straightened the situation out.

Hearing this, Jiang Chen finally understood why Guo Shan was crying, it was all because Jiang Chen had successfully concocted a high ranked Profound Six Solar Pill in just one and a half days. Guo Shan was a respectable alchemist in the Qi Province, so this had dealt a really huge blow to his pride.
“Brother, this really is a huge blow to me.”

Guo Shan was happy, but at the same time, he felt somewhat depressed. He was happy because Jiang Chen had finally concocted the Profound Six Solar Pill, and that meant Yan Chenyu wouldn’t die. However, he was depressed because Jiang Chen had dealt a huge blow to his face. He thought that no matter how much of a genius Jiang Chen was, he would need at least 3-4 days to concoct the pill, but he had never thought it would only take him one and a half day. Also, judging from the color of the pill, it was a 100% effectiveness pill. His pill concoction skill was simply astonishing.
“Older brother, don’t cry... You have learned the Great Soul Derivation skill, your alchemy skills will definitely become much stronger! I’ll go save Little Yu now.”
Jiang Chen patted Guo Shan’s shoulder to show his comfort. After that, he walked towards the direction where Yan Chenyu was resting.

Guo Shan let out a long sigh, then he followed Jiang Chen. Jiang Chen’s existence had taught him what a miracle was. From now onwards, no matter what kind of heavenly defying things happened around Jiang Chen, Guo Shan would never behave like this again.
Yan Chenyu was still laying on the bed within the room quietly, she looked like a sleeping beauty.

Jiang Chen squatted down next to her. He placed his palm on her cold face, then he gently said, “Little Yu, it was Big Bro Jiang Chen’s fault for not being able to protect you. When you recover, I promise; I won’t let you suffer any grievances. Whoever dares bully you, I will kill them.”
Jiang Chen’s voice was soft and gentle, but Guo Shan could feel the determination and cruelty within. No words from this man could be taken as a joke.

Jiang Chen placed the Profound Six Solar Pill into Yan Chenyu’s mouth. When the pill entered her body, in an instant, a massive amount of energy emerged from her body. In just a brief moment, a golden colored light barrier appeared outside her body. Yan Chenyu was still sleeping quietly within the barrier. The golden light barrier was like a cocoon that protected Yan Chenyu, waiting for her to break free and be reborn.

“The Profound Six Solar Pill’s power will be able to guarantee that Little Yu stays alive. She will also be absorbing strength from the pill bit by bit, Little Yu’s cultivation will keep progressing even while she is sleeping. In the future, when I find the Nine Solar Holy Water and let her drink it, Little Yu will immediately wake up, and her cultivation will soar.”
Jiang Chen explained.

Guo Shan nodded his head. He had no doubts about Jiang Chen’s words, the Profound Six Solar Pill contained Firethorn Savage’s demon soul, and its value was simply enormous. If it had the Nine Solar Holy Water instead, not to mention Yan Chenyu who had a Divine Body which possessed the Nine Yin Meridians, even an ordinary man would become a genius, and his cultivation would soar as well.
“Older brother Guo, I’ll probably go to Inferno Hell in a few days. You’ll have to help me take good care of Little Yu and Brother Yan.

After saving Yan Chenyu, Jiang Chen’s next goal was to enter Inferno Hell and find the Earthly Demon Beast. Han Yan was his first brother after reincarnating, as well as his only brother; so he had to save him no matter what.
“Brother, do you really want to enter Inferno Hell?”
When mentioning Inferno Hell, Guo Shan couldn’t help but furrow his brows. That place was an extremely dangerous place, it was best not to go there.

“I have a great interest in this Inferno Hell. It also happens to be that I need to go there in order to save Brother Yan as well. Since Guan Yiyun was brave enough to enter, there is nothing that I, Jiang Chen need to be afraid of.”

Jiang Chen said with a serious expression. He loved adventures and challenges, it gave him some meaning to life. Besides, by cultivating the Dragon Transformation skill, he would need to go through a certain amount of challenges before yielding any progress. The Dragon Transformation skill only got harder and harder to cultivate the more you broke through. Therefore, Jiang Chen would take this opportunity to enter Inferno Hell.
“Big Yellow, the trip to Inferno Hell is extremely dangerous; you can choose not to follow me, I won’t force you.”
Jiang Chen looked at Big Yellow as he spoke.

“Damn it, how could you leave me behind when going to such a dangerous place? Let me tell you this buddy, there is no way you can ditch me and go off by yourself! Daddy is going to this Inferno Hell with you no matter what!”
Big Yellow raised his prideful head and spoke with an arrogant tone.
“Haha, good!”

Jiang Chen burst out into laughter, and he felt somewhat touched in his heart. Although his and Big Yellow’s relationship had started after an intense fight, after spending so much time together and having gone through so many events, they had built a deep relationship. No matter what Jiang Chen was going to do, no matter how dangerous it seemed, Big Yellow always willingly followed him. From killing Lord Blood Moon to Firethorn Savage, Big Yellow had always been a great help.
Besides, when this dog followed him, the help he provided was enormous.

After settling his matters with Yan Chenyu, Jiang Chen could finally have a peace of mind; he felt relaxed at last. The same night, outside of Guo Shan’s herb plantation, Jiang Chen, Guo Shan and Big Yellow sat around a stone table, drinking together. And of course, they were drinking the best wine that Guo Shan had brewed.
Swoosh!
Suddenly, a figured descended from the skies above and appeared next to the table. The man didn’t show any formality, he just sat down and grabbed the wine pot, then he drained it with one gulp.
“Sect Chief, this is so rude of you, you didn’t even ask me for permission; that wine was mine.”
Guo Shan mockingly said. The man who suddenly arrived was the Black Sect’s Sect Chief, Daoist Black.
“What? Daddy only drank a mouthful of your wine, how could you be so stingy?”
It was rare for Daoist Black to be so gracious.
“I’m sure Sect Chief is here for a reason.”
Jiang Chen said as he cupped his fist towards Daoist Black.
“Indeed, I’m here to inform you about something, it will give you a sense of crisis.”
Daoist Black said as he looked at Jiang Chen.
“Sense of crisis? I suppose it is related to Nanbei Chao?”
Jiang Chen was a brilliant man, something that could attract Daoist Black’s attention and was related to Jiang Chen, it must be something related to Nanbei Chao.

“That’s right. I just got some news saying Nanbei Chao has broken through to the Divine Core realm. This isn’t what’s special, the important part is that he has been chosen by the Martial Palace, and is now a disciple of the Martial Palace.”
When mentioning the Martial Palace, Daoist Black couldn’t help but express a slight hint of respect on his face.
“What? Nanbei Chao was chosen by the Martial Palace?!”
Guo Shan exclaimed as if he had just heard something really shocking.
With a puzzled expression, Jiang Chen asked, “Martial Palace, what’s that?”
“Jiang Chen, it looks like you don’t have much knowledge about the distribution of powers in the Eastern Continent. Do you know anything about the Martial Saint Dynasty?”
Daoist Black asked.

Jiang Chen shook his head. He had never heard about the Martial Saint Dynasty before. Since he ventured from Red City, through Origin Mountain, and into the Qi Province, he hadn’t made any other stops. There were a total of 28 provinces in the Eastern Continent, and there were many powerful sects and clans with complicated relationships. He was not familiar with any of them at all.

“Younger brother, the Martial Saint Dynasty is the giant of the Eastern Continent. You could say that they’re the power who rules the entire Eastern Continent. The Martial Palace was established by the Martial Saint Dynasty, and its purpose is to cultivate all geniuses amongst every single province in the Eastern Continent.
Guo Shan explained.

“I see. With Nanbei Chao’s talent and potential, it’s only natural for him to be chosen by the Martial Palace. Oh right, since this Martial Saint Dynasty rules the entire Eastern Continent, I suppose the Qi Province is ruled by it as well... But why has nobody mentioned it before?”
Jiang Chen asked.

“It’s a shame, actually. The Qi Province is one of the weakest provinces in the Eastern Continent, and the Martial Saint Dynasty has never taken us seriously. In fact, none of the big sects in the Qi Province are even qualified to be ruled by the Martial Saint Dynasty. There are quite a few geniuses from the four big sects, and all of them broke through to the Divine Core realm before they became 30 years old and became core disciples, but none of them ever attracted the Martial Saint Dynasty’s attention. Therefore, they could only journey into more powerful provinces to train themselves further. It’s the first time in history that the Martial Saint Dynasty came to the Qi Province to invite Nanbei Chao to become their disciple; this really proves how incredible Nanbei Chao’s potential is. Right now, Nanbei Chao has broken through to the Divine Core realm, and the pressure on you has become larger.”

Daoist Black said with a worried tone. Nanbei Chao was the first man from the Qi Province to become a disciple of the Martial Saint Dynasty. His existence was not only a threat to Jiang Chen, he also posed a threat to all the other 3 big sects in the Qi Province. It would just take him a few years before the current situation in the Qi Province changed completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - Heavenly Sword Sect’s Yun Can
paragraphs: At this moment, both Daoist Black and Guo Shan were immersed in deep thought and silence. The Qi Province was just one of the weakest provinces in the Eastern Continent. It’s overall strength was pretty similar to the Qian Province’s overall strength. Compared to the other powers, the difference was huge. There wasn’t even a single Combat Soul warrior in the entire Qi Province.

That was the reason why the Martial Saint Dynasty had abandoned these two provinces. Both of them really were the weakest provinces in the Eastern Continent. Supposedly, Daoist Black should be feel happy that that the Martial Saint Dynasty came to the Qi Province to invite a genius to join them, because it’s good fortune for the Qi Province. But, he didn’t feel happy at all, and he believed that the Heavenly Sword Sect and Valley of Happiness felt the same.

They all knew very well what kind of person Nanbei Chao was. He was not someone who would be content with a small place like this. Even if he wasn’t invited to join the Martial Palace, the overall picture of the Qi Province would still be broken apart by this man. Once Nanbei Chao joins the Martial Palace and gets cultivated by both the Martial Palace and the Martial Saint Dynasty, his cultivation level will soar up into the skies. With the intense relationship between the Qi Province’s four big sects, all three other sects would have to soon face a huge threat.

But Jiang Chen who was sitting opposite of them had an excited expression. His mind was experiencing a huge fluctuation now. He never feared his enemy becoming strong, because in his mind, the more powerful his enemy was, the bigger challenge he would have to face. The discovery of the Martial Saint Dynasty and Martial Palace had sent a turmoil through his mind. In an instant, he had discovered a new target; the Martial Saint Dynasty and the Martial Palace.

Nanbei Chao was someone who wouldn’t be content with a small place, and Jiang Chen was a true dragon who would sooner or later soar through the highest of heavens. The small Qi Province was just a tiny stepping stone for Jiang Chen’s grand future, and thus, the Martial Palace and the Martial Saint Dynasty had become his next target.

Jiang Chen had great ambitions and sooner or later, he would reach the top of the Eastern Continent and begin his journey back to the Divine Continent. He would reclaim what belonged to him in his previous life. His Saint Sword was still residing in Cliff of Saints, and 100 years ago, he had used it to split open the doorway to the Realm of Immortals. In this life, he was going to slice the heavens.
This was Jiang Chen’s grand ambition. The Qi Province was just his first step towards his final goal, the Martial Saint Dynasty and the Martial Palace was his next step.

“That doesn’t matter to me. The stronger Nanbei Chao becomes, the better it will be. I’m never afraid of my opponent becoming stronger. If not, the one-year fight appointment would just be meaningless. Sect Chief, don’t worry too much, the overall state of the Qi Province will soon change, and it won’t take long before it happens. However, it won’t be because of Nanbei Chao, but me, Jiang Chen.”

Jiang Chen slowly stood up from his seat. With both hands behind his back, and his head tilted a little bit upwards, he stared at the moon above the skies with a pair of bright eyes. The energy he emitted couldn’t be ignored.

Daoist Black and Guo Shan looked at each other, both of them could see a shocked look in their eyes. Jiang Chen had always given them a different kind of impression, and right now, this young man right in front of them seemed so mighty. It was the spirit of one trying to reach the top of the heavens. He was just standing there, but he gave them an impression that he was someone above all, making it impossible for them to not admire him.

“Fine, Jiang Chen, you’re truly amazing. Your potential is actually much greater than Nanbei Chao’s, and I truly hope the Black Sect will have a peerless genius. And I wish that one day, the Black Sect’s name will be known throughout the entire Eastern Continent.”
Daoist Black stood up, then he patted Jiang Chen’s shoulder and left.
“Brother, you’re a man full of miracles, there is nothing in this world that you cannot accomplish. I believe that even Nanbei Chao can’t get in your way.”

Guo Shan sincerely said, “However, you cannot underestimate Nanbei Chao. He has now broken through to the Divine Core realm, so you need to have a sense of urgency, and you can’t relax with your cultivation.”

“I found a treasure during my trip to Misty Mountain, and with it, I believe I can break through to the Late Heavenly Core realm. Older brother Guo, I’ll return to my place and enter secluded cultivation, please help me take good care of Little Yu and Brother Yan.”
Jiang Chen cupped his fist towards Guo Shan.
“Brother, you just focus on your cultivation, your brother I will take care of everything here.”
Guo Shan patted his own chest as he promised.

Jiang Chen led Big Yellow and left Guo Shan’s mountain peak, then he returned to his own courtyard. Although he had broken through to the Heavenly Core realm, he still hadn’t officially become an inner circle disciple, so he was still staying at the same place.

Of course, Jiang Chen didn’t really care about the inner circle title. With his current reputation in the Black Sect, even the Divine Core Sect Elders had to be respectful in front of him. That title meant nothing for him.

The damaged courtyard had already been repaired by Wang Yun and the other disciples, and it looked just like it previously did. When Jiang Chen returned to his courtyard, he immediately entered secluded cultivation.

“Big Yellow, I’m going to enter secluded cultivation and absorb this golden egg, and I think I need about 1-2 days to do it. Please help me guard the place for the time being, don’t allow anyone to disturb me during this period.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Damn you, you always ask daddy here to do it! Master dog is a mighty existence, but you still ask me to guard the place for you!”
Big Yellow said with a slight hint of depression in his words.

Jiang Chen rolled his eyes, then he slapped Big Yellow’s head. He immediately recalled that every time he had asked Big Yellow to guard while he cultivated, this dog had gone to sleep. Of course, Big Yellow would yield a leap in his cultivation every time he woke up from his slumber.

“Damned dog, shut up and do as I say, unless you’re going to sleep. However, if you do go to sleep, you better break through to the Divine Core realm! If you don’t guard me during my secluded cultivation, and don’t break through to the Divine Core realm, daddy here will break your dog balls for sure!”
After threatening Big Yellow, Jiang Chen turned around and walked into his room while ignoring the murderous glare from Big Yellow.
“How dare he threaten to break my dog balls?! This is ridiculous! Damn it, master dog is so pissed off, ruff ruff ruff! Damn buddy, daddy will bite your butt once your finish cultivating!”
Big Yellow grinded his teeth as he bounced and rolled around angrily in the courtyard.
Within the room, Jiang Chen was sitting on a cushion with his legs crossed. He adjusted himself to an optimal condition, then he retrieved the golden egg from his storage ring.

“This golden egg contains the source energy of Firethorn Savage, and the energy is massive. If I can absorb it all, I will be able to form another 100 Dragon Marks and break through to the Late Heavenly Core realm. When that time comes, those ordinary Mid Divine Core warrior won’t be my match any more.”

Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up. This golden egg was definitely an unexpected gain during his trip to Misty Mountain. He was soon going to enter Inferno Hell, and it was a place filled with great dangers. If he was able to break through to the Late Heavenly Core realm and increase his overall combat strength, then that would give him more confidence when entering Inferno Hell.

Besides, Jiang Chen witnessed how Firethorn Savage fought, he had a really great interest in his innate ability. The ability gave him a powerful defense, as well as an attack. If Jiang Chen was able to inherit Firethorn Savage’s innate ability, it would give him another really powerful skill.
Buzz...
Buzzing started sounding out from Jiang Chen’s body. The Dragon Transformation skill had begun circulating at full speed and absorbing the golden egg bit by bit.
Early morning the next day, when the sun appeared in the skies far away, a loud shout suddenly sounded out near the Black Sect’s main gate.
“Jiang Chen, come out and face your death now!”

The shout was loud as a clap of thunder, and it sounded out throughout the entire Black Mountain. The sound waves turned into ripples which swept across the entire place, causing everyone in the Black Sect to hear it loud and clearly.
“Who the hell is that? Why is he shouting near the main gate so early in the morning? Does he think the Black Sect has no one who can defeat him?”
“Damn it, who the fuck is that, how dare he come to our Black Sect and ask senior disciple Jiang to face his death? Is he here to commit suicide?”

“I think he came here to commit suicide. Last time this happened, that Li Wuling from the Heavenly Sword Sect came here early in the morning and wanted to kill senior disciple Jiang to avenge his brother, Li Wushuang, but in the end, he was killed by senior disciple Jiang.”
“Let’s go check it out, let’s find out who is seeking his own death so eagerly.”
Soon after, many disciples emerged from the Black Sect. All inner circle disciple were flying towards the scene, and the outer circle disciples were sprinting towards the scene.

Right at this moment, above the skies outside the Black Sect, a man wearing a grey robe was floating in the skies. The man looked to be in his late twenties, he had a handsome face, and he portrayed a domineering image. He was unleash an imposing energy, and his killing intent was soaring.
A short sword was embroidered on the man’s chest; it was the Heavenly Sword Sect symbol.
“Damn it, he is from the Heavenly Sword Sect, but who is this guy? Why have I never seen him before?”
“Such powerful energy, he is a Divine Core warrior! Since when did the Heavenly Sword Sect have such a young Divine Core warrior?”

“I know him, his name is Yun Can. He was once the number one genius in the Heavenly Sword Sect, and he broken through to the Divine Core realm two years ago and became one of the few Heavenly Sword Sect’s core disciples. After that, he went somewhere to train, and now he is back."

“What? A Heavenly Sword Sect core disciple? Any disciple from the four big sects who can break through to the Divine Core realm before becoming 30 years old would become a core disciples, but there is only a limited number of core disciples, and most of them have gone to some bigger places to train. Thus, most of them are not residing within their respective sects. I think this Yun Can is here to kill senior disciple Jiang and avenge Liang Xiao.”

Many people recognized this man, he was a core disciple from the Heavenly Sword Sect. In the Qi Province, core disciples was just a symbolic title. Normally, there wouldn’t be more than 2 core disciples in every individual sect. Those who could become a core disciples was usually a rare genius, and all of them had their own prides. Once they broke through to the Divine Core realm, they would leave the Qi Province and cultivate themselves in bigger and stronger provinces.

Yun Can was a rare genius from the Heavenly Sword Sect. He had broken through to the Divine Core realm two years ago and had left the Heavenly Sword Sect, and he just came back recently and learned that Liang Xiao was killed by Jiang Chen. That’s why he became so angry and came to the Black Sect to kill Jiang Chen.

“A core disciple, that’s a real genius! Those Sect Elders of the Heavenly Sword Sect couldn’t attack senior disciple Jiang personally after he killed Liang Xiao, and there are no more disciples who can defeat senior disciple Jiang amongst all younger generation disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect. Since Yun Can is back, they can use a younger generation genius to challenge another one, that would give them an excellent excuse.”

“Those core disciples are all abnormal monsters! Although Yun Can is only an Early Divine Core warrior, he is able to fight a Mid Divine Core warrior! I’m afraid senior disciple Jiang won’t be his match at all.”

chapters.title: Chapter 190 - Qing Styx’s fury
paragraphs: The arrival of Yun Can had shaken the entire Black Sect. At the same time, the name of Yun Can began spreading across all disciples. Many of them had heard his name before, but they had never seen him in person. He was after all one of the legendary men from the Heavenly Sword Sect, and was very famous two years ago. If anyone said they had never heard his name before, they should be ashamed.

The news about Jiang Chen killing Liang Xiao had spread across the entire province, and of course, the Heavenly Sword Sect had gotten the news as well. Liang Xiao was the number one genius of the Heavenly Sword Sect, and it there were no accidents, he would become the next core disciple. His death had definitely made the Heavenly Sword Sect suffer a great loss.

If it was a Divine Core Sect Elder from the Black Sect who killed Liang Xiao, the Heavenly Sword Sect would definitely erupt with anger and go all out against the Black Sect. But, Liang Xiao was killed by Jiang Chen. Besides, when Jiang Chen killed Liang Xiao, he had a much weaker cultivation level compared to Liang Xiao, and everybody knew this.

There was an unwritten rule amongst the four big sects of the Qi Province, so it was rare for an elder to get involved in the fights amongst younger generation geniuses. So, it all depended on their own abilities to fight each other and decided who the last one standing would be.

Therefore, although the Heavenly Sword Sect was extremely angry and wished to tear Jiang Chen into pieces, their elders didn’t dare openly come to the Black Sect to find trouble with Jiang Chen, they couldn’t shame their own faces. The number one genius from the Heavenly Sword Sect was killed by a new rising star of the Black Sect, and this brought huge disgrace onto the Heavenly Sword Sect. Besides, it happened because Liang Xiao tried assassinating Jiang Chen, and therefore, the Heavenly Sword Sect’s management couldn’t openly get revenge.

And even if they did want to avenge Liang Xiao, they would have to wait until Jiang Chen left the Black Sect. Jiang Chen had become stronger and stronger, and it seemed like he was going to become the second Nanbei Chao. All elders of the Heavenly Sword Sect wished to kill Jiang Chen as quickly as possible, but they simply couldn’t do it with him still being within the Black Sect.

The return of Yun Can had given the Heavenly Sword Sect an opportunity to kill Jiang Chen. Yun Can was also a genius of the younger generation, and no one would say anything bad about a young generation genius fighting another one. As long as they could kill Jiang Chen, not only would the blood debt caused by Liang Xiao’s death be paid off, it would also make the Heavenly Sword Sect rise in fame. But, the most important thing was that Jiang Chen would be killed.
“Jiang Chen, don’t be a shirker, come out and face your death! Yun Can from the Heavenly Sword Sect is here to challenge you!”
Yun Can’s challenge surged throughout the entire Black Mountain.

“Fuck, why is every single person from the Heavenly Sword Sect so shameless? Last time it was that Li Wuling, and now it’s this Yun Can! Senior disciple Jiang is only a Mid Heavenly Core warrior, but this Yun Can is a well-known Divine Core warrior, and he doesn’t even feel ashamed about challenging a Mid Heavenly Core warrior.”

“That’s right, if senior disciple Jiang was a Divine Core warrior, this Yun Can would be running as far away from here as possible the moment he heard senior disciple Jiang’s name. I don’t think he would have the courage to come here.”

“Senior disciple Jiang used his true abilities to kill Liang Xiao, and according to what I know, it was Fan Kun who secretly informed Liang Xiao and had him ambush senior disciple Jiang. But in the end, he failed and got killed by senior disciple Jiang, so he can only blame himself for lacking abilities. I think this Yun Can is similar to Liang Xiao.”

Yun Can’s arrogant attitude had pissed off many disciples of the Black Sect, but although they were angry, no one really dared stand out and confront Yun Can. The Black Sect’s core disciples were still away from the sect.

Within the Black Sect, Guo Shan who was resting and cultivating heard the shouts as well. His expression instantly changed, and at the same time, Big Yellow flew towards Guo Shan while shouting, “Old man Guo Shan, hurry up and get rid of that stupid guy. Jiang Chen is in a critical moment of his cultivation, he has no time to fight that guy now.”
“Alright, I’ll go right now.”
Guo Shan nodded his head. He knew that Big Yellow was speaking the truth. He immediately stood up and flew towards the Black Sect’s main gate.

“Old man Guo Shan, tell that guy he will have to wait another two days if he wants to challenge Jiang Chen. Two days later, Jiang Chen will beat him so much that his mother will be unable to recognize him.”
Big Yellow said.
“Haha, fine.”

Guo Shan laughed out heartily. He believed Big Yellow’s words. Currently, Jiang Chen was able to kill any ordinary Early Divine Core warriors, and he might not be able to defeat a genius like Yun Can. However, if Jiang Chen broke through to the Late Heavenly Core realm, that would be a completely different story, and Yun Can would definitely not be his match. Jiang Chen would be able to crush him in an instant.
“Jiang Chen, why have you still not come out?”
Yun Can was extremely aggressive as he kept shouting for Jiang Chen.
“Shut up!”

Right at this moment, a loud shout sounded out from within the Black Sect. In the next second, everyone at the scene saw Sect Elder Guo Shan coming with great speed and an angry expression on his face.
“Yun Can, why are you shouting from the Black Sect’s entrance so early in the morning? Didn’t your parents teach you any manners? Do you believe I won’t kill you right now?”
Guo Shan said in a stern manner.
“Hmph! Try to kill me? Unless you really have some abilities, I don’t have time for you! Let that Jiang Chen out right now, I want to kill him today and avenge junior disciple Liang Xiao!”

Yun Can let out a cold snort. He simply looked down at Guo Shan. Core disciples were usually proud and thought nothing about others. Although Guo Shan was one level higher than him, if they really engaged in a fight, Guo Shan would have a hard time defeating him.
Yun Can had broken through to the Divine Core realm two years ago, and he was now a peak Early Divine Core warrior now, just a few steps away from breaking through to the Mid Divine Core realm.

“Let me tell you this, Jiang Chen has no time for you now. However, if you want to challenge him, you’ll have to wait for two more days. In two days, he will beat you so much that even your mother will be unable to recognize you. If you keep yelling without any manners, don’t blame me for sending someone powerful to attack you now.”
Guo Shan sneered.

“Haha, Yun Can, did you hear that? In two days, senior disciple Jiang will beat you until your mother can’t recognize you anymore! I think you better hurry up and get lost, and avoid coming here again! You don’t want what happened to Liang Xiao to happen to you, really.”
“That’s right, senior disciple Jiang never shows any mercy when he attacks! If you get yourself killed here, nobody will help bury your dead corpse. It would be a really tragic death.”
Wang Yun and Huang Zheng were trash talking and laughing out loudly.
“Hmph! Presumptuous! Fine, I’ll return in two days. Tell Jiang Chen to wash his neck for me. Two days later, I, Yun Can, will return once again, and kill him!”
After saying that, Yun Can turned around and left.
“Senior disciple Jiang really accepted Yun Can’s challenge... Is it because he’s close to another breakthrough?”

“It’s hard to tell. Senior disciple Jiang is probably in secluded cultivation right now, he might be able to breakthrough again during these two days, and if that is the case, he will be able to defeat Yun Can without many problems.”

“You’re right, senior disciple Jiang is a peerless genius, his potential is no less than Nanbei Chao’s. His cultivation speed is extremely fast, and he can’t be judged with ordinary standards. Besides, senior disciple Jiang would never do something he wasn’t completely confident about. If he says he’ll accept Yun Can’s challenge in two days, that means he really has the confidence to do so.”
“Haha, if senior disciple Jiang really kills a core disciple from the Heavenly Sword Sect, his fame will definitely grow exponentially, and it’ll prove that he is able to fight Nanbei Chao!”
All the disciples of the Black Sect carried excited looks on their faces. Jiang Chen’s reputation had left an eternal mark in their hearts.
At the same time, Qian Province, Green Sanctuary Sect.

Early in the morning, a figure flew out from the Green Sanctuary Sect with extreme speed. In just a few breaths time, he arrived at Misty Mountain’s outer perimeter. The man was the Green Sanctuary Sect’s Sect Chief, Qing Styx.

Qing Styx suffered pretty serious injuries during his battle with Firethorn Savage, but he had now fully recovered from that. The first thing he wanted to do now that he had fully recovered was to kill Firethorn Savage and get rid of the Green Sanctuary Sect’s biggest rival.

“Firethorn Savage, I know you are in a serious weakened state right, so let me see how you are going to fight me. As long as I can kill you, this mountain will belong to the Green Sanctuary Sect, and we will be able to enter the third sector whenever we want!”

A prideful smile emerged on Qing Styx’s face. He seemed to be in high spirits, and he was imagining what would happen after he killed Firethorn Savage. Not only would the Green Sanctuary Sect get complete control over Misty Mountain, with the help of Firethorn Savage’s demon soul, he would certainly be able to break through the bottleneck that had trapped him for so many years and reach the Combat Soul realm.

Qing Styx flew above the skies of Misty Mountain. He held a spear in his hand, and with every step he took, his energy level would rise. Therefore, when he arrived at the center of Misty Mountain, his energy level had become extremely strong, and he portrayed an enormous killing intent. His combat strength had also been adjusted to its maximum.
“Firethorn Savage, come out and face your death!”

Qing Styx’s shout shook the entire sky. At the same time, he arrived in front of Firethorn Savage’s scene. The scene in front of him made him trip on his own feet, and he almost fell down from the skies.

He saw Firethorn Savage, but what he saw was a dead body. The entire field located in the middle of the mountain had been splashed with Firethorn Savage’s blood. It had been two days, but the blood hadn’t completely dried up yet.
Firethorn Savage’s body was covered in wounds, his brain was dug out, and cracks could be seen everywhere. A violent fight had obviously happened here.
“How could this be possible? Who did this?”
Qing Styx was stunned. In an instant, all his dreams about the Green Sanctuary Sect’s future, all his great plans, were all shattered.
With a blink of his eyes, Qing Styx entered the cave and found out the golden egg was missing as well. The situation almost made him throw up a mouthful of blood.
Qing Styx started breathing rapidly with extreme fury. It felt like someone had stolen his most precious and cherished treasures.

“Jiang Chen, it must be that young man whose name is Jiang Chen! Firethorn Savage was his real target, and he used the golden egg to frame my Green Sanctuary Sect and make us fight Firethorn Savage, and in the end, he was the one to reap all the harvest! What a crafty trick, damn it! This is ridiculous!”

In an instant, Qing Styx understood everything. Anyone could use their nose to understand what had happened by looking at the mess in front. What Qing Styx had not expected was that Firethorn Savage’s weakened state was so weak that he couldn’t even defend himself from a Heavenly Core young man and a dog. If he knew he was so weak, Qing Styx wouldn’t spend two days to recover his injuries, he would have just attacked right away.
“Jiang Chen, I’ll definitely kill you!”

sentences.text: The arrival of Yun Can had shaken the entire Black Sect.
At the same time, the name of Yun Can began spreading across all disciples.
Many of them had heard his name before, but they had never seen him in person.
He was after all one of the legendary men from the Heavenly Sword Sect, and was very famous two years ago.
If anyone said they had never heard his name before, they should be ashamed.
The news about Jiang Chen killing Liang Xiao had spread across the entire province, and of course, the Heavenly Sword Sect had gotten the news as well.
Liang Xiao was the number one genius of the Heavenly Sword Sect, and it there were no accidents, he would become the next core disciple.
His death had definitely made the Heavenly Sword Sect suffer a great loss.
If it was a Divine Core Sect Elder from the Black Sect who killed Liang Xiao, the Heavenly Sword Sect would definitely erupt with anger and go all out against the Black Sect.
But, Liang Xiao was killed by Jiang Chen.
Besides, when Jiang Chen killed Liang Xiao, he had a much weaker cultivation level compared to Liang Xiao, and everybody knew this.
There was an unwritten rule amongst the four big sects of the Qi Province, so it was rare for an elder to get involved in the fights amongst younger generation geniuses.
So, it all depended on their own abilities to fight each other and decided who the last one standing would be.

Therefore, although the Heavenly Sword Sect was extremely angry and wished to tear Jiang Chen into pieces, their elders didn’t dare openly come to the Black Sect to find trouble with Jiang Chen, they couldn’t shame their own faces.
The number one genius from the Heavenly Sword Sect was killed by a new rising star of the Black Sect, and this brought huge disgrace onto the Heavenly Sword Sect.
Besides, it happened because Liang Xiao tried assassinating Jiang Chen, and therefore, the Heavenly Sword Sect’s management couldn’t openly get revenge.
And even if they did want to avenge Liang Xiao, they would have to wait until Jiang Chen left the Black Sect.
Jiang Chen had become stronger and stronger, and it seemed like he was going to become the second Nanbei Chao.
All elders of the Heavenly Sword Sect wished to kill Jiang Chen as quickly as possible, but they simply couldn’t do it with him still being within the Black Sect.
The return of Yun Can had given the Heavenly Sword Sect an opportunity to kill Jiang Chen.
Yun Can was also a genius of the younger generation, and no one would say anything bad about a young generation genius fighting another one.
As long as they could kill Jiang Chen, not only would the blood debt caused by Liang Xiao’s death be paid off, it would also make the Heavenly Sword Sect rise in fame.
But, the most important thing was that Jiang Chen would be killed.
“Jiang Chen, don’t be a shirker, come out and face your death!
Yun Can from the Heavenly Sword Sect is here to challenge you!”
Yun Can’s challenge surged throughout the entire Black Mountain.
“Fuck, why is every single person from the Heavenly Sword Sect so shameless?
Last time it was that Li Wuling, and now it’s this Yun Can!
Senior disciple Jiang is only a Mid Heavenly Core warrior, but this Yun Can is a well-known Divine Core warrior, and he doesn’t even feel ashamed about challenging a Mid Heavenly Core warrior.”
“That’s right, if senior disciple Jiang was a Divine Core warrior, this Yun Can would be running as far away from here as possible the moment he heard senior disciple Jiang’s name.
I don’t think he would have the courage to come here.”
“Senior disciple Jiang used his true abilities to kill Liang Xiao, and according to what I know, it was Fan Kun who secretly informed Liang Xiao and had him ambush senior disciple Jiang.
But in the end, he failed and got killed by senior disciple Jiang, so he can only blame himself for lacking abilities.
I think this Yun Can is similar to Liang Xiao.”
Yun Can’s arrogant attitude had pissed off many disciples of the Black Sect, but although they were angry, no one really dared stand out and confront Yun Can.
The Black Sect’s core disciples were still away from the sect.
Within the Black Sect, Guo Shan who was resting and cultivating heard the shouts as well.
His expression instantly changed, and at the same time, Big Yellow flew towards Guo Shan while shouting, “Old man Guo Shan, hurry up and get rid of that stupid guy.
Jiang Chen is in a critical moment of his cultivation, he has no time to fight that guy now.”
“Alright, I’ll go right now.”
Guo Shan nodded his head.
He knew that Big Yellow was speaking the truth.
He immediately stood up and flew towards the Black Sect’s main gate.
“Old man Guo Shan, tell that guy he will have to wait another two days if he wants to challenge Jiang Chen.
Two days later, Jiang Chen will beat him so much that his mother will be unable to recognize him.”
Big Yellow said.
“Haha, fine.”
Guo Shan laughed out heartily.
He believed Big Yellow’s words.
Currently, Jiang Chen was able to kill any ordinary Early Divine Core warriors, and he might not be able to defeat a genius like Yun Can.
However, if Jiang Chen broke through to the Late Heavenly Core realm, that would be a completely different story, and Yun Can would definitely not be his match.
Jiang Chen would be able to crush him in an instant.
“Jiang Chen, why have you still not come out?”
Yun Can was extremely aggressive as he kept shouting for Jiang Chen.
“Shut up!”
Right at this moment, a loud shout sounded out from within the Black Sect.
In the next second, everyone at the scene saw Sect Elder Guo Shan coming with great speed and an angry expression on his face.
“Yun Can, why are you shouting from the Black Sect’s entrance so early in the morning?
Didn’t your parents teach you any manners?
Do you believe I won’t kill you right now?”
Guo Shan said in a stern manner.
“Hmph!
Try to kill me?
Unless you really have some abilities, I don’t have time for you!
Let that Jiang Chen out right now, I want to kill him today and avenge junior disciple Liang Xiao!”
Yun Can let out a cold snort.
He simply looked down at Guo Shan.
Core disciples were usually proud and thought nothing about others.
Although Guo Shan was one level higher than him, if they really engaged in a fight, Guo Shan would have a hard time defeating him.
Yun Can had broken through to the Divine Core realm two years ago, and he was now a peak Early Divine Core warrior now, just a few steps away from breaking through to the Mid Divine Core realm.
“Let me tell you this, Jiang Chen has no time for you now.
However, if you want to challenge him, you’ll have to wait for two more days.
In two days, he will beat you so much that even your mother will be unable to recognize you.
If you keep yelling without any manners, don’t blame me for sending someone powerful to attack you now.”
Guo Shan sneered.
“Haha, Yun Can, did you hear that?
In two days, senior disciple Jiang will beat you until your mother can’t recognize you anymore!
I think you better hurry up and get lost, and avoid coming here again!
You don’t want what happened to Liang Xiao to happen to you, really.”
“That’s right, senior disciple Jiang never shows any mercy when he attacks!
If you get yourself killed here, nobody will help bury your dead corpse.
It would be a really tragic death.”
Wang Yun and Huang Zheng were trash talking and laughing out loudly.
“Hmph!
Presumptuous!
Fine, I’ll return in two days.
Tell Jiang Chen to wash his neck for me.
Two days later, I, Yun Can, will return once again, and kill him!”
After saying that, Yun Can turned around and left.
“Senior disciple Jiang really accepted Yun Can’s challenge...
Is it because he’s close to another breakthrough?”
“It’s hard to tell.

Senior disciple Jiang is probably in secluded cultivation right now, he might be able to breakthrough again during these two days, and if that is the case, he will be able to defeat Yun Can without many problems.”
“You’re right, senior disciple Jiang is a peerless genius, his potential is no less than Nanbei Chao’s.
His cultivation speed is extremely fast, and he can’t be judged with ordinary standards.
Besides, senior disciple Jiang would never do something he wasn’t completely confident about.
If he says he’ll accept Yun Can’s challenge in two days, that means he really has the confidence to do so.”

Qing Styx suffered pretty serious injuries during his battle with Firethorn Savage, but he had now fully recovered from that.

Qing Styx flew above the skies of Misty Mountain.

Chapter 191 - Elite Trouble Maker

Qing Styx was furious, extremely furious. His lungs seemed like they were going to explode due to the unbearable madness. When a man was filled with hope, and had even seen the lights of these hopes in front of him, but suddenly discovers that all his hopes had become illusions, and everything had shattered like glass; this kind of emotion was not something ordinary people could understand.

The Green Sanctuary Sect and Firethorn Savage had fought a violent battle which had resulted in severe damage to both sides. At the same time, Firethorn Savage was the Green Sanctuary Sect’s biggest hope for rising. Qing Styx was dying to become a Combat Soul warrior and rule the entire Qian Province, he was longing for the Qian Province to become like the other provinces who also had Combat Soul warriors. He wanted to get the Martial Saint Dynasty’s attention.
But it was now gone, it was all gone.

Firethorn Savage’s demon soul was gone, but Qing Styx still brought the body with him. He carried the mountain-like body back to the Green Sanctuary Sect. Firethorn Savage’s body was filled with useful things, and just his fur alone would be enough to make a lot of defensive items.
On the same day after Qing Styx returned to the Green Sanctuary Sect, he immediately summoned a few Divine Core warriors and proceeded towards the Qi Province.
“Bastard! This is ridiculous! That little bastard really killed Firethorn Savage while he was in his weakest state, he has taken everything that belongs to the Green Sanctuary Sect!”
“Kill him, we must destroy him and get rid of our great hatred!”
“Let’s go, proceed to the Black Sect! We’ll ask Daoist Black to hand over Jiang Chen, and if he refuses then the Green Sanctuary Sect will become his enemy!”

All the Green Sanctuary Sect Elders were filled with righteous rage, and fury could be seen on their faces. The situation made it seem like Jiang Chen had just abducted their daughters, causing a deeply rooted hatred.

Qing Styx had become really furious this time. If he couldn’t kill Jiang Chen, a knot would form in his heart, and if he allowed this to keep pressuring him, he would never be able to break through to the Combat Soul realm for the rest of his life.

The mighty Green Sanctuary Sect was a respected sect in the Qian Province, but it was fooled by a young man. If they couldn’t do something about it and bring back their reputation, the Green Sanctuary Sect would become a laughing stock in the Qian Province.

Right at this moment, Jiang Chen was completely immersed in a state of cultivation, and all his focus was on absorbing the golden egg. Therefore, he didn’t pay any attention to what was happening outside.

The golden egg the size of a human’s head was revolving in midair in front of Jiang Chen. Countless blood red Dragon Marks dashed out from Jiang Chen’s body and covered the entire golden egg. The energy contained within the golden egg started flowing into Jiang Chen’s body, and with help from the Dragon Transformation skill, the energies were quickly transformed into the purest energy, then it entered Jiang Chen’s Qi Sea and circulated around his Heavenly Core, and started forming into new Dragon Marks.

Completely absorbing the golden egg was no easy task, it had to be done bit by bit. If it was absorbed too fast, the energy contained within would be wasted. In any case, Jiang Chen had plenty of time right now, so he wanted to fully utilize this golden egg and break through to the Late Heavenly Core realm.

After a restless night, a quarter of the golden egg had been absorbed, helping Jiang Chen form 25 Dragon Marks, making it a total of 328 Dragon Marks in his body. This was the terrifying power of the Dragon Transformation skill, with each new Dragon Mark formed, Jiang Chen’s overall combat strength would increase.

Jiang Chen was cultivating with a peace of mind right now, and Big Yellow was fulfilling his duty by guarding outside. However, none of the Black Sect disciples could have a peace of mind now. The arrival of Yun Can had created a turmoil amongst them, everyone knew what was going to happen in two days. If Jiang Chen really broke through, a violent fight was inevitable.
Late in the afternoon, another disturbance happened outside the Black Sect’s main gate. More than five overbearing energies were quickly approaching.
“Little bastard Jiang Chen, come out and face your death!”

A frightening loud shout sounded out throughout the mountains. The sound waves were many times more powerful than Yun Can’s, and even though it came from a distance far away, it still made many people feel pain in their ears.
“What the fuck, again?! What happened? When is this going to end?”
“Damn it, what did Jiang Chen do, why are there so many people with grudges looking for him? Look at them, I think their hatred towards Jiang Chen is extremely huge.”

“Since senior disciple Jiang came to the Black Sect, trouble has come with seemingly no stop; there is no peace in the inner circle or the outer circle. Senior disciple Jiang really is a devil incarnate, my idol!”

All Black Sect disciples were soon going to throw up their blood. All of them were wondering what had happened today; Yun Can just left in the morning, and later that day, another group of people who wanted to kill Jiang Chen appeared. Judging from their energies, this group was much more powerful than Yun Can.
Swoosh swoosh swoosh...

Once again, many disciples emerged from their locations. They were now even faster than they were in the morning, all of them wanted to see who were coming for Jiang Chen, and find out what Jiang Chen had actually done.

Outside the Black Sect’s main gate, a group of five old men were floating in the skies. All of them wore the same green uniform, and the leading man had the strongest energy, which was no weaker than Daoist Black’s.
“Heavens, where did these men come from? Their cultivation bases are so strong!”
“I can sense that the cultivation of their leader is no weaker than Sect Chief! However, I have never seen these people before... Since when did the Qi Province have so many strong warriors?”

“They are definitely not from the other three big sects, perhaps they aren’t even from the Qi Province? Oh my, what has senior disciple Jiang done? Look at their faces, it seems like they’re going to eat someone alive!”

When these disciples found out the cultivation levels of this group of people, all of them were shocked. The overall strength of these people were many times stronger than Yun Can. However, none of them knew where they came from. So many Divine Core warriors just to hunt Jiang Chen down, this could be considered as another kind of ability. None of the disciples here had the ability to make something like this happen.
“Get that Jiang Chen out here as soon as possible, I want him to hand over Firethorn Savage’s demon soul! If not, I won’t let him off easily today!”
Qing Styx’s shout was like a massive clap of thunder, vast and mighty.
“Who dares wreak havoc in the Black Sect?!”

At this point of time, a shout similar to Qing Styx’s shout sounded out from the Black Sect’s inner area. In the next second, Daoist Black was seen flying through the skies. He arrived in front of the Black Sect’s front gate, and next to him there was a few more Divine Core Sect Elders, Guo Shan included.
“Who are you, and why are you shouting in front of the Black Sect’s front gate?”
Daoist Black glanced at Qing Styx and a few others. He was not familiar with these people.

“Judging by your cultivation level, I suppose you are Black Sect’s Sect Chief, Daoist Black? I am the Green Sanctuary Sect’s Sect Chief, Qing Styx. We travelled far for one single reason; we want Jiang Chen. We have no intention to seek conflict with the Black Sect, so as long as you can hand Jiang Chen over to us, we’ll turn around and leave immediately.”

Qing Styx went straight to the point. He guessed that Firethorn Savage’s demon soul was still with Jiang Chen, and therefore, as long as he could find Jiang Chen, there was still a chance for him to retrieve the demon soul.
“What? The Sect Chief from a big sect in the Qian Province came all the way to the Black Sect personally? When did Jiang Chen go to the Qian Province to cause trouble?”

“Damn, Jiang Chen really is a devil incarnate! Not only did he cause so much trouble in the Qi Province, he even went to wreak havoc in the Qian Province. What did he do to the Green Sanctuary Sect that pissed them off so much?”
“What is a Firethorn Savage? Jiang Chen is a man who can really do a lot of things.”

Hearing that these men had come from the Qian Province, and that they were all Sect Elders of a big sect, including the Sect Chief, everyone on the spot became speechless. Jiang Chen’s ability to cause trouble was really good.
“Firethorn Savage’s demon soul?”

Daoist Black furrowed his brows. Perhaps no one else here knew what a Firethorn Savage was, but he knew about this demon beast. There was a Firethorn Savage residing within Misty Mountain, Qian Province, but it was impossible for Jiang Chen to obtain its demon soul.
“Sect Chief, let me explain what happened to you.”

Guo Shan immediately summarized all the information and passed it onto Daoist Black through his Divine Sense, giving him a picture of what had happened. In order to save Yan Chenyu, Jiang Chen had gone to Misty Mountain to hunt for Firethorn Savage, and in the end, he had used the Green Sanctuary Sect and caused them to suffer great losses.

After digestion all the information, Daoist Black became stunned. Jiang Chen really killed a peak Mid Divine Core Firethorn Savage, and he even obtained its demon soul. If Guo Shan hadn’t told him this personally, Daoist Black would have never believed it at all.
“Good, perfect! This young man will definitely become someone great in the future!”

Facing this threatening group of men from the Green Sanctuary Sect, not only did Daoist Black not feel any panic or nervousness, he was excited. Being able to accomplish something so huge, it proved that Jiang Chen was a man with careful thoughts. At the same time, it also proved he was brave. A genius like this would definitely grow to be someone great in the future.
“Qing Styx, don’t you think that it is inappropriate for you to come here, in front of the Black Sect’s front gate to ask for our disciple?”
Daoist Black said.

“Daoist Black, Jiang Chen has cruelly killed the Sect Elders and disciples of the Green Sanctuary Sect, and he also framed us, causing us to suffer massive damage! The reason I am here today is to kill him, and I don’t think Daoist Black will want to offend a big sect like ours just for a tiny little disciple, right?”
Qing Styx said.

“I’m sorry, but I have to disappoint Qing Styx. I, Daoist Black am well known for being over protective with my own disciples. Besides, the Green Sanctuary Sect is such a big sect, and yet, you can’t even fight a ‘tiny little disciple’ of mine, and you even suffered massive damage? You should stay at home and do some self-reflection. Why do you still have the nerve to come here and ask me to hand my disciple over to you? Qing Styx, I think you better return to where you came from.”
Daoist Black said with a smile on his face. In his mind, Jiang Chen was his most precious disciple, so there was no way he would hand him over to them.
“That’s right, you are such a big sect, but you still suffered massive losses because of senior disciple Jiang, that’s really shameful! How do you still have the dignity to come here?”
Some disciples shouted.
“Daoist Black, no matter what, I, Qing Styx want to bring Jiang Chen away today! Do you really want to make the relationship between the Black Sect and the Green Sanctuary Sect become tense?”
Qing Styx was still furious.
“Hmph! Look carefully at where you are standing right now! This is the Qi Province, not your Qian Province! Don’t tell me you’re going to attack us with just the few of you?”

Daoist Black let out a cold snort. As the Sect Chief, he had to behaving domineeringly. Not just because he wanted to protect Jiang Chen, even if it was just an ordinary disciple, he wouldn’t just hand him over easily. If he really did do so, he would lose the trust of all his disciples, and he would have a hard time managing the Black Sect.
“Sect Chief, Daoist Black’s words are correct. This is the Qi Province, and we hold no advantages if we were to strike.”
Liu Hong whispered to Qing Styx.
“Hmph! I can’t return empty handed! Besides, that little bastard Jiang Chen might not have had the time to absorb Firethorn Savage’s demon soul yet, we can’t just give up right now.”

Qing Styx let out a cold snort. Firethorn Savage’s demon soul could help him achieve his dream, there was no way he could just give it up so easily. However, this Daoist Black just didn’t want to give way, and if they really wanted to strike, they were going to suffer losses for sure.
