Chapter 196 - Entering Inferno Hell
Jiang Chen stood high in the skies with his domineering attitude, portraying an overwhelming image as he looked down on his enemies in front of him, he was challenging the world.

The Green Sanctuary Sect, the Heavenly Sword Sect, the Burning Sky Pavilion. He alone was challenging all three big sects. Such a statement, there was only one person in the entire Qi Province who could speak these words, and that was Jiang Chen.
After saying those words, Jiang Chen turned around and started walking towards the inner area of the Black Sect. His figure attracted many gazes, and they were all filled with admiration.

Respect, fear, admiration; each of these gazes were filled with mixed emotions. Every single man dreamt about reaching the top of the world, all men wished to defeat all enemies who got in his path and leave behind a mighty legend. In every single era, there was a star of the generation, and everyone dreamt about becoming that star.
Everyone were sighing inwardly. Living in the same era as Jiang Chen, it was their fortune, but at the same time, their misfortune.

Jiang Chen walked with spirited and vigorous steps, and his eyes were glittering. As man with a great destiny, he wanted to live a glorious life after his reincarnation. He wanted to be a man who could walk everywhere underneath the heavens, following nothing but his heart’s desires while killing all who got in his way. This could only be done by a man with huge courage and resolution.
“What an overbearing man! He is like a shining sun, no dark clouds can cover his glory!”

“Senior disciple Jiang is my number one idol! If I can one day portray the same domineering attitude as him, challenging the entire world; even if I would die in the next second, there would be no regret in my life!”
“A man like him is destined to leave a glorious mark in history! He is a peerless genius who can’t be found, even in a thousand years! I’m afraid that only Nanbei Chao can be his match...”

The disciples of the Black Sect were still staring at Jiang Chen’s back. Although he had disappeared from the scene, they still didn’t want to take their eyes off where he had gone. He had become a role model amongst the younger generation, he was the Black Sect’s pride.
“Ahh... let me fight, I want to fight with him!”

Huo Yuner roared out in fury. Flames danced around him, and his eyes had turned red. Jiang Chen’s words had seriously injured his self-esteem, the self-esteem of a genius which couldn’t be stepped on. Therefore, even if he would die fighting Jiang Chen, he wanted to do it.

Huo Yuner’s cultivation had gone smooth as sailing ever since he was born, he and Yun Can were famous in their respective provinces, and they stood on top amongst everyone in the younger generation. Huo Yuner was the number one genius of the Green Sanctuary Sect, and everyone there feared him, so he had never suffered such insults before. He had come and provoked Jiang Chen today, but he was scared off fighting even before the fight begun, and this was a tremendous loss of face.
“Huo Yuner!”

Qing Styx shouted, then he said, “You are not his match! Besides, didn’t you hear what he just said? He is going to enter Inferno hell, hmph! I’m sure you know just how dangerous this Inferno Hell is, even I would have a slim chance of survival if I were to enter. This guy is so prideful and arrogant, he is just seeking his own death by entering Inferno Hell!”

Hearing Qing Styx’s words, the crowds finally woke up. The expressions of all the disciples changed. They had been stunned by Jiang Chen’s mighty manner just now, therefore, no one really paid attention when he said Inferno Hell. After being reminded by Qing Styx, they finally responded.
“What? Senior disciple Jiang is going to enter Inferno Hell? That is too dangerous!”

“I heard that senior disciple Guan Yiyun has entered Inferno Hell as well, but he was looking for an opportunity to break through to the Divine Core realm, therefore he made up his mind and entered. He vowed he would either successfully break through, or die in there. However, senior disciple Jiang’s potential is much better than senior disciple Guan Yiyun’s, I don’t see why it’s necessary for him to risk his life in Inferno Hell.

“You know nothing! Senior disciple Jiang is an abnormal monster! Obviously, he will choose to talk an extraordinary path! For us, this Inferno Hell is a gateway to hell, but for him, it’s just a challenge.”

The crowds were shocked by the news, Jiang Chen’s decision was too frightening. Inferno Hell was originally used by all the powerful sects in the different provinces, including the Martial Saint Dynasty, to punish the men who had committed serious crimes. They would throw these criminals into Inferno Hell and let them run their own course inside.

Of course, there had been many brave men who entered Inferno Hell because of their own will to have life and death experiences. Rumors say that there is great fortune hiding somewhere within, and as long a man can leave the place alive, he would experience a transformation from his roots. The transformation did not only affect the cultivation, but also the person’s mindset. Anyone who had encountered life and death situations would have strong mindsets that others couldn’t compare with.
“This guy really wants to enter Inferno Hell? What exactly is he after?”

Daoist Black reacted as well, his brows were knit in a frown. In his mind, Jiang Chen was the Black Sect’s most precious disciple, so he didn’t want to see anything bad happen to him. Because Jiang Chen was the only man who could fight Nanbei Chao, he was also the Black Sect’s only hope of changing their destiny. If anything bad happened to Jiang Chen, Nanbei Chao would sooner or later destroy the Black Sect.
“Let’s go.”

Qing Styx shook his head helplessly with an look of extreme disappointment on his face. Judging from today’s situation, he had lost all his hope of obtaining Firethorn Savage’s demon soul. He was standing in the heart of the Black Sect, and with the presence of Daoist Black, there was no way for him to kill Jiang Chen. The initial plan of having his core disciple, Huo Yuner, fight with Jiang Chen, didn’t work out either. Not only that, he had to make sure Huo Yuner didn’t act impulsively, in order to save his life. If not, he would just experience the same as Yun Can.
“I’ll enter Inferno Hell and fight him!”

Huo Yuner strengthened his resolve and became the first one to fly towards the Qian Province, while leaving a blazing trail of scorching hot flames in his path. What happened today was a huge blow to him. Jiang Chen had left a permanent dark shadow in his mind. If he couldn’t get rid of this shadow, it would become a ghost which would keep hunting him and make his cultivation come to a standstill.
In order to get rid of this shadow, he had to fight Jiang Chen. No matter what, he would either die or live in the end.
“Sigh!”

All the Green Sanctuary Sect Elders let out sighs. They hurried up and started following Huo Yuner. It was such an ironic scene; the Green Sanctuary Sect had come here in an imposing manner, but in the end, they had to leave in such a miserable way.

Jiang Chen was still alive, and they didn’t retrieve Firethorn Savage’s demon soul. Not only that, he even delivered a huge blow to Huo Yuner’s face. Huo Yuner was a precious disciple of the Green Sanctuary Sect, he had been gifted a powerful flame skill since birth and was previously cultivating in the Karst Cave. If nothing bad happened to him, he would have broken through to the Mid Divine Core realm in no time. But what happened today, it had dealt him a huge blow which directly affected his cultivation progress.
Yun Can was killed, and Huo Yuner had left. Jiang Chen had once again strengthened his mighty position in the Black Sect.
Guo Shan’s mountain peak.
“Jiang Chen, do you really want to enter Inferno Hell? With your potential, there is no need for you to cultivate in such a dangerous place.”
Daoist Black asked with a frown on his face.
“Sect Chief, I have made up my mind, we don’t need to discuss this any further. I just hope that the Sect Chief can open the path to Inferno Hell for me.”
Jiang Chen said.

“Jiang Chen, you probably have no idea how dangerous Inferno Hell is. Even I do not dare enter. I tried persuading Guan Yiyun to not enter, but he insisted. However, you really don’t have any reason to cultivate in Inferno Hell.”

Daoist Black had a puzzled expression as he looked at Jiang Chen. In fact, Daoist Black had no idea about what was in Inferno Hell, as he had never gone there before. There were only a handful of men who had entered Inferno Hell before, and that’s why almost no one knew what exactly could be found within. The only thing people knew was that it was a frightening place filled with dangers, and chances of survival are very slim.
“Sect Chief, the reason why brother Jiang insists on entering Inferno Hell is to save Han Yan.”
Guo Shan tried explaining.
“To save Han Yan?”
Daoist Black was startled.

“That’s right, Brother Yan’s condition is too severe, and his life-force is almost gone. All his internal organs have shattered, and he is only surviving because of the Ancient Divine Devil’s bloodline. I’ve placed him within the Blood Banner with hope that the demonic energy contained within can give him some help. However, in order to completely save him, I’ll need the Earthly Demon Beast’s demon soul. Brother Guo told me that a rare demon beast like that might only exist in Inferno Hell, that’s why I must go there.”

Jiang Chen then said with a serious expression, “Brother Yan is my brother, his life is equal to mine. Even if it requires me to climb a mountain of swords and dive into a sea of flames, I’ll still save him; even if Yama wants to take my life, he will have to ask my permission.” [1]

When mentioning Han Yan, Jiang Chen couldn’t help but feel a pain in his heart. This was his first brother after his reincarnation, and he had risked his life to save Jiang Chen’s girl during a critical moment. Jiang Chen would never forget what he had done for him, and as long as Han Yan still had vital signs, Jiang Chen would risk everything to save him.

Hearing Jiang Chen’s explanation, Daoist Black’s mouth opened wide, but he couldn’t say a word. He felt guilty when Jiang Chen mentioned Han Yan and Yan Chenyu, and he didn’t even dare look into Jiang Chen’s eyes.

“Therefore, there is no need for Sect Chief to say anything more regarding this matter. In my eyes, Brother Yan’s life is most important, so I have to go to Inferno Hell no matter what. Besides, all of you are afraid of this place, but I have never feared it. No matter how dangerous the place is, it will be nothing but a training ground for me.”
Jiang Chen expressed a high amount of confidence, the confidence of the once greatest Saint in the world.

“Good, Jiang Chen, you slaughter with a firm resolution, I’m sure you will become a very capable person! You show no mercy to your enemies, but to your own brothers, you are a man with a true heart! I, Daoist Black respect you, and I need to take responsibility for what happened to Little Yu and Brother Yan as well, but I can’t do anything else than apologize. I’ll open the path to Inferno Hell for you. Remember, be extra careful upon entering!”
Daoist Black didn’t try to convince Jiang Chen anymore. He knew that once Jiang Chen made up his mind, there was nothing that could change it.
“Alright. Sect Chief, please wait for me at Palace Black, I need to arrange something with brother Guo.”
Jiang Chen said.
Daoist Black nodded his head and flew away.
“Brother, you are a man with a great destiny. I’m sure you’ll be able to come back from Inferno Hell, and you might even encounter some big opportunities.”
Guo Shan said.

“Older brother Guo, I don’t know how long I’ll be in there, so I need you to take really good care of Little Yu and Brother Yan. Later, I’ll transfer the control of the Blood Banner to you. Although it is an evil weapon, it is still a very strong one, and it will provide you great help.”
Jiang Chen decided to leave the Blood Banner behind. Firstly, it could help Han Yan. Secondly, if there was an emergency, Guo Shan could put it to good use.
Fan Zhongtang was soon going to exit the Cliff of Remorse, and Jiang Chen was really worried about that cunning old fox.
Footnotes:
1 - Yama, the King of Hell.

Even if it requires me to climb a mountain of swords and dive into a sea of flames, I’ll still save him; even if Yama wants to take my life, he will have to ask my permission.” [1]
When mentioning Han Yan, Jiang Chen couldn’t help but feel a pain in his heart.
This was his first brother after his reincarnation, and he had risked his life to save Jiang Chen’s girl during a critical moment.
Jiang Chen would never forget what he had done for him, and as long as Han Yan still had vital signs, Jiang Chen would risk everything to save him.
Hearing Jiang Chen’s explanation, Daoist Black’s mouth opened wide, but he couldn’t say a word.
He felt guilty when Jiang Chen mentioned Han Yan and Yan Chenyu, and he didn’t even dare look into Jiang Chen’s eyes.
“Therefore, there is no need for Sect Chief to say anything more regarding this matter.
In my eyes, Brother Yan’s life is most important, so I have to go to Inferno Hell no matter what.
Besides, all of you are afraid of this place, but I have never feared it.
No matter how dangerous the place is, it will be nothing but a training ground for me.”
Jiang Chen expressed a high amount of confidence, the confidence of the once greatest Saint in the world.
“Good, Jiang Chen, you slaughter with a firm resolution, I’m sure you will become a very capable person!
You show no mercy to your enemies, but to your own brothers, you are a man with a true heart!
I, Daoist Black respect you, and I need to take responsibility for what happened to Little Yu and Brother Yan as well, but I can’t do anything else than apologize.
I’ll open the path to Inferno Hell for you.
Remember, be extra careful upon entering!”
Daoist Black didn’t try to convince Jiang Chen anymore.
He knew that once Jiang Chen made up his mind, there was nothing that could change it.
“Alright.
Sect Chief, please wait for me at Palace Black, I need to arrange something with brother Guo.”
Jiang Chen said.
Daoist Black nodded his head and flew away.
“Brother, you are a man with a great destiny.
I’m sure you’ll be able to come back from Inferno Hell, and you might even encounter some big opportunities.”
Guo Shan said.
“Older brother Guo, I don’t know how long I’ll be in there, so I need you to take really good care of Little Yu and Brother Yan.
Later, I’ll transfer the control of the Blood Banner to you.
Although it is an evil weapon, it is still a very strong one, and it will provide you great help.”
Jiang Chen decided to leave the Blood Banner behind.
Firstly, it could help Han Yan.
Secondly, if there was an emergency, Guo Shan could put it to good use.
Fan Zhongtang was soon going to exit the Cliff of Remorse, and Jiang Chen was really worried about that cunning old fox.

1 - Yama, the King of Hell.

Chapter 197 - The Miserable Monster
After Guo Shan had obtained complete control of the Blood Banner, Jiang Chen brought Big Yellow with him and left Palace Black.

Decades ago, Blood Moon Shaman had used the Blood Banner to wreak havoc in the Qi Province. He was invincible back then mostly because of the Blood Banner. Since Guo Shan was a Mid Divine Core warrior, there was no problems with him controlling it. With the Blood Banner’s help, Guo Shan’s combat strength would improve significantly, and Fan Zhongtang would not be his match.
That’s the reason Jiang Chen felt safe in leaving Yan Chenyu and Han Yan behind. He had to leave to help Han Yan, he didn’t want to see anything bad happening to him again.
Within Palace Black, Daoist Black had been waiting for quite some time. When he saw Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, he immediately walked towards them.
“Jiang Chen, the trip to Inferno Hell really isn’t something fun. I still hope you can give it a second thought.”
Daoist Black reminded Jiang Chen once more with a serious tone.
“I won’t change my mind. Sect Chief, please open up the path to Inferno Hell for me.”
Jiang Chen had a determined look, he was going to Inferno Hell no matter what.
“Fine, follow me.”
Daoist Black didn’t say anything else. He led Jiang Chen and Big Yellow towards the depths of Palace Black.

They came across a long corridor, which they could clearly feel was leading downwards. The corridor was pretty dark, and after having traveled around three miles, a steel door appeared in front of them.
“I didn’t know there was such a place hidden in the Black Sect.”
Jiang Chen felt surprised. There was nothing special outside Palace Black, and he had never expected a hidden place like this within.
“The portal to Inferno Hell is mysterious, we need to hide it properly.”
Daoist Black said.
“It’s right behind this steel door?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“That’s right.”

Daoist Black waved his hand and unleashed a beam of light onto the steel door. A click immediately sounded out from the door. It looked like it hadn’t been opened for quite a long time, or perhaps it had only been opened a few times, which is why it produced such a rusty sound when opening.

Behind the steel door was a spacious secret chamber, and it was sealed on all sides. Right in the middle of the secret chamber there was an illusory portal. It was floating endlessly like water while emitting bright lights.
“A portal!”
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up, he was very familiar with this kind of portal, so he could tell what it was with just a single look.
“That’s right, it’s the portal to Inferno Hell.”
Daoist Black nodded his head.

“Last time, Guan Yiyun told me it was an ancient portal, but this portal doesn’t look old at all. I think it was made by a Combat King warrior. The man who made this is really skillful with formations, the portal is different from all other kinds of portals and formations, and it’s related to the dimensional forces. Without advanced knowledge about formations, ordinary Combat King warriors would never be able to make a real portal.”
Jiang Chen said with a calm voice.

Daoist Black’s expression changed. He stared at Jiang Chen with awe. Once again, he had been shocked by Jiang Chen. This portal had been here for decades, and even Daoist Black couldn’t tell anything about it. But Jiang Chen, he was able to tell everything about it with just one look, and he could even tell that it was made by a Combat King warrior.

A Combat King warrior, a mighty Combat King, an ultimate person who has mastered the dimensional forces, that’s someone who stands at the top of the world, a man Daoist Black couldn’t even imagine. His life’s biggest goal was to reach the Combat Soul realm. As for the mighty Combat King realm, he could only dream about it during his deep slumber.

“This portal was given to us decades ago by the Martial Saint Dynasty. I suppose every single big sect in all 28 provinces of the Eastern Continent has the same portal. Even I don’t know anything about this portal, I didn’t expect it was made by a Combat King warrior.”

Daoist Black had mixed feelings about this. The Martial Saint Dynasty ruled the entire Eastern Continent, and they had given the same portal to every single big sect and made sure that each province had this portal so that they could send people into Inferno Hello. Even the Qi Province and the Qian Province had this portal.
“Looks like there is a Combat King warrior in the Martial Saint Dynasty, not bad.”

Jiang Chen nodded his head. It looked like this Martial Saint Dynasty was much stronger than he had expected. A Combat King warrior, it was considered a reputable existence, even in the Divine Continent. It’s quite normal for the Martial Saint Dynasty to have a Combat King warrior, as they ruled the entire Eastern Continent.
“Sect Chief, hurry up and activate the portal.”
Jiang Chen didn’t want to waste any more time.
“Fine.”

Daoist Black nodded his head. With a flip of his palm, he retrieved a golden colored token from his storage ring. It was about the size of a palm, and it looked to fit right into the slot located at the center of the portal.
Daoist Black took a step forward and slowly placed the token into the portal. An instant later, the portal produced a buzzing sound, then it started functioning.
Swoosh swoosh...
Followed by the activation of the portal, a wild wind swept across the entire secret chamber. Dimensional forces were leaking out from the portal, making it difficult for them to breath.
Buzz...

Not long after that, a pitch black tunnel appeared right in the middle of the portal. Freezing winds immediately violently blew out from it. It was so cold that it felt like it was coming from an eternal darkness, it sent a shiver down the spines of all who heard it.

Even Daoist Black’s expression changed upon sensing this. Jiang Chen, however, was standing right in front of the storm with an indifferent expression. He actually felt a sudden nostalgia from this feeling. Big Yellow stuck his tongue out and felt excited as well. This dog doesn’t fear danger, he became excited upon encountering danger. He and Jiang Chen loved adventures, they liked the feeling of excitement.
“Hurry, the tunnel can only be maintained for three breaths time.”
Daoist Black hurriedly said.
“Big Yellow, let’s go.”
Jiang Chen leapt forward and disappeared into the tunnel. Big Yellow followed closely behind him and disappeared into the tunnel at the same time.
Click!

Right as Jiang Chen and Big Yellow disappeared, the tunnel instantly closed. The portal had also stopped functioning. The golden token popped out from the slot and fell right into Daoist Black's hand.
Daoist Black stared motionlessly at the portal, then he said to himself, “Jiang Chen, I really hope you can come out from Inferno Hell safely. The Black Sect’s future destiny is in your hands.”
Swoosh... swoosh...
The freezing wild wind never seemed to stop. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were moving along the flow, there were whirlwinds everywhere, and the tunnel looked variegated.

The tunnel was pretty narrow actually, it only allowed one person to pass through at one time, so it caused Big Yellow’s body to feel a tight squeeze. The whirlwinds kept blowing into the tunnel, causing their faces to hurt.
“Damn it, fuck! What kind of a shitty trash tunnel is this?!”
Big Yellow kept cursing. The tunnel seemed shaky and unstable, as if it was going to collapse at any time.

“That Combat King warrior seems to have just mastered the dimensional forces. He was using an advanced portal to construct this dimensional tunnel, therefore, it isn’t stable. We better be careful. Do not unleash any energy here, if we drift into some dimensional turbulence, it will be huge trouble!”
Jiang Chen reminded.
“Damn it, if we drift into a dimensional turbulence, we’ll be trapped for more than a hundred years!”

Big Yellow felt even more depressed. He looked around and found out there were multicolored dimensional turbulences everywhere. Also, from time to time, a massive dimensional typhoon would appear in their sights. Luckily, it was Jiang Chen and Big Yellow who was here. If it was any other ordinary person, they would probably be pissing their pants due to fear.

Dimensional turbulence, that was a place where coldness and darkness blended together. It was tough to find a dimensional node within, and even a Combat King warrior who has mastered the dimensional forces would find it hard to get out from it. Only those mighty Combat Emperors would be able to walk out from it with ease.
Besides that, the dimensional typhoon within the dimensional turbulences was the deadliest existence. It was just a dreadful monster that would cause anything that gets dragged into it to perish.

Jiang Chen had a bitter smile on his face. If this was his past life, he would be able to go anywhere in this world with the Dimensional Shift skill. Entering Inferno Hell would take him just a few seconds.

The mighty Saint warriors had all completely mastered the dimensional rules, they could walk anywhere they wanted amongst the dimensional space. Also, any Saint who has mastered the Dimension Shift skill could break open dimensional barrier with their bare hands and walk in like it was their backyard.
No matter what, it was all history now. Currently, Jiang Chen was just a small potato at the Heavenly Core realm, he had a long way to go.

Within the teleportation tunnel, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were admiring the breath-taking dimensional turbulence around them while chit-chatting. After staying for a full day in the tunnel for an entire day, the duo finally saw a light at the end of the tunnel.
“We’re almost there.”
Seeing this, Jiang Chen’s spirit rose.
“Damn it, finally, we can leave this damned place! I wonder what Inferno Hell looks like.”
Big Yellow was so excited that he jumped up from where stood with his tongue sticking out from his mouth. With his jump, he made a crack in the tunnel.
“Damned dog, you better be careful! Daddy doesn’t want to drift into a dimension turbulence and die at this young age!”
Jiang Chen slapped Big Yellow’s head, scolding him in a hopeless manner.

The light at the end of the tunnel became brighter, and soon after, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow arrived at the end of the tunnel. The duo held their breath as they were getting ready to enter Inferno Hell.
Right now, within Inferno Hell, some place within an abyss.

It was a foggy place, and everything here looked gray. The abyss was a completely desolated area, and rocks were everywhere. A monster with a body fully covered with black scales was roaming around in this area.

This monster was over 3 meters tall, its whole body was fuming with frightening black mist. It only had one eye, which was positioned vertically right in the middle top of his face. It also only had one nostril and one huge mouth below the eye. The eye, nose and the mouth, they were all lined up in a straight line, and it looked really fearsome and savage.
The monster was roaming around, its eyeball was rolling around in full alert, as if it was searching for something.
Suddenly.
Bang!

A loud banging sound could be heard from the skies above. It was as loud as a fierce thunder strike. A hole in the dimension appeared, and a figure shout out from it. The monster was shocked by the sound, so it raised its head to look towards the direction. In an instant, an unknown object fell onto its head.
Plop!

The arrival of this unknown object was so sudden, this monster didn’t even have time to react. Also, the object carried a massive amount of force when fell onto his head, this monster cried out horribly and started rolling on the floor.
Roar!

The monster was furious. It immediately stood up on the ground to look at the unknown object, then another loud bang sounded out from above. Once again, another unknown object fell onto its head. When the unknown object hit its head, the monster could hear it scolding out loudly, “Damn it, what a shitty tunnel!”

chapters.title: Chapter 198 - Inferno Hell’s Evil Devil and Nine Life Crystal Beast
paragraphs: The first unknown object that fell onto the monster was Jiang Chen. After him, it was Big Yellow. When the duo came out from the dimensional tunnel, they were pushed around by the dimensional turbulence and were squeezed out from the tunnel. The force pushed them tremendously, giving them no chance at controlling their bodies.
“The fuck, what is this?”

Big Yellow was laying on the floor when he was shot out, that’s why his head was facing downwards and he could see the monster below him immediately. In an instant, his head start glowing in a golden light, then he forcefully rammed towards the monster’s head.
Bang!
Blood splashed everywhere, the monster’s head exploded into a mess.

The most miserable thing in this world must be this monster. If it could still stand up and say something, it would definitely both its eyes woukd tear up. No, it would its single eye would tear and cry, “Oh heavens and earth, what have I done wrong to deserve this?”

Not only was it hit by something unknown without having the time to react, but it was immediately hit a second time as well. Fine, it could still bear it, but now, they even took away its life by crushing its head. What happened to this world?
Big Yellow fell onto the ground, rolled, and then stood up, then he walked up to Jiang Chen and looked at the monster who was lying on the ground.
“What is this thing? It looks so ugly! Still, this master dog is the most handsome being in this world!”
No matter where Big Yellow went, he just couldn’t get rid of his narcissistic character.
“Big Yellow, it was you who killed it by ramming into its head.”
Even Jiang Chen felt speechless. What a miserable way to die.
“It scared me just now, so I couldn’t help it, that’s why I crashed into it with my head. But, I never thought it would be so weak!”
Big Yellow licked his lips.

Jiang Chen rolled his eyes and said, “Look at this poor fellow, it was only an Early Heavenly Core monster, how could it defend itself from your dog head? Not only this, based on the suddenness of the situation just now, it was killed by you before it even had the time to react, you’re brutal!”
Big Yellow’s head could even penetrate Firethorn Savage, let alone this tiny Early Heavenly Core monster. That’s why it was instantly killed by Big Yellow.
“It was his unlucky day.”

Big Yellow nodded his head. After that, he looked around and said, “I don’t think our look is any good either. Why does this damn abyss feel so ghastly? There is gray fog everywhere! Luckily, this fog can’t hurt us.”
Jiang Chen’s expression became serious, and he looked around as well.
“I think that all places in Inferno Hell are like this. They shouldn’t be a sun or moon here. It looks like an individual parallel dimension. However, the environment here is really bad.”
Jiang Chen did expect such a bad environment in Inferno Hell. If this place was a paradise, no one would fear it so much. Only a foul environment like this could deserve the name Inferno Hell.
“What is this monster? It doesn’t look like a demon beast, I think it’s a rare creature.”
Big Yellow turned around and threw and examining look at the dead monster, but he couldn’t tell anything about it.

“I saw what it looked like just now. It only had one eye, one mouth, and one nose. The energy coming from it was not demon energy, but a shivering devil energy. So, I think it’s a devil. I know that there is a kind of devil with a weird look, they are extremely ferocious, and the only have one eye, one nose and one gigantic mouth. They are also the devils of all sins. I think it’s called the Evil Devil. If my guess is correct, this is an Evil Devil.”

Jiang Chen carefully examined the monster. Indeed, it was an Evil Devil. In his past life, he had dealt with a lot of devils, but he had never seen something like this before. However, he did know some ancient legends about it.
“You even know about this?”
Big Yellow widened his eyes as he looked at Jiang Chen.

“Of course I know about it! Devils aren’t easy to deal with. According to the legends, this kind of devil has a really strong body and incredible muscles, and its most powerful weapon is its vertical eye which can unleash a mystical light that can cause damage directly to one’s soul. It is extremely frightening. However, according to legends, these Evil Devils only exist in the ancient eras, and should be extinct by now. I never expected to see one still here. Looks like this Inferno Hell is pretty amazing.

Jiang Chen sighed inwardly. He was told by Guo Shan that the Inferno Hell had suddenly appeared one hundred years ago, and it was all because he had swung his sword towards the heavens, damaging all dimensional spaces in Saint Origin in the process, which caused all these strange dimension and beings to appear.
“You consider this a strong body and incredible muscles? Do you still remember the legend properly?”
Big Yellow snorted.
“Damn it, no matter how strong it is, how can it be compared to you? Even Firethorn Savage couldn’t withstand your dog head!”
Jiang Chen really wished he could step on Big Yellow’s face right now. Not only was this guy incredibly narcissistic, his sarcastic remarks angered him as well.
“You’re right! I, the master dog, have a copper head and iron bones! Even if the ancestor of this Evil Devil was here, it wouldn’t be able to withstand a single head slam from this master dog!”
In an instant, Big Yellow became narcissistic again.

“Inferno Hell is indeed an extraordinary place. The air is filled with devil energy, and there’s also all sorts of demon energies. I supposed there are all kinds of devils and demons here. Besides, since even the Evil Devil could be found here, I think we’ll most likely find the Earthly Demon here as well.”

Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up. The existence of Evil Devil allowed him to see new light. The main reason why he came here was to hunt for the Earthly Demon, and if there was no Earthly Demon here, the trip would be a waste of time.
Big Yellow walked towards the Evil Devil. Using his hooves, he forcefully kicked it and retrieved its devil soul.
“Buddy, since you’re able to absorb any demon soul, I wonder if you can absorb this devil soul?”
Big Yellow said as he threw the devil soul directly towards Jiang Chen.

“The skill I am cultivating allows me to absorb any bloodline in this world. If I can absorb a demon soul, I don’t see any problem with me absorbing devil soul. Besides, I now have the True Dragon Flames, which is the king of all beast flames, and it’s capable of burning down anything in this world. It’s the perfect enemy for all evil beings, I’ll be able to burn off all evil and impurities within this devil soul, and turn it into the purest energy which I can immediately absorb.”

After saying this, Jiang Chen shot out a sheet of flames from his palm, covering the entire devil soul. After that, cracking sound came out from the devil soul, and in an instant, the devil soul was completely purified and turned into a glowing energy object.
“What a freak!”

Although he already knew how abnormally insane Jiang Chen was, Big Yellow still rolled his eyes in shock. Doesn’t matter if it was a demon soul or a devil soul, none of them could be absorbed by a human being, because they contained too much non-human elemental impurities. Absorbing it by force would seriously impact the person’s cultivation, and it could even make them enter a state of psychosis.
Jiang Chen forcefully clenched his fist. Followed by a cracking sound, the devil soul shattered. It turned into bright sparks which all entered Jiang Chen’s body.

“An Early Heavenly Core devil, it’s really weak, and it doesn’t have any more effect on me. If we bump into any more devils later on, we’ll still gather their devil souls, as I think it will be able to help Brother Yan.”
After saying that, he shot out a ball of True Dragon Flames and burned the body to ashes.
Roar~

Right at this moment, a loud roar sounded out from somewhere not far away from where they stood. It sounded deep, and a little hoarse, which made it extremely awful. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow immediately turned around and looked into the direction. In an instant, they saw a monster which was glowing brightly appearing not far away from them, and it was slowly walking towards them.
The monster was obviously attracted by the smell of blood.
“What kind of monster is this?”

Big Yellow was startled. The monster wasn’t tall, it was just a little bit taller than an average human. The body didn’t look very muscular either, but it gave them an overbearing impression. This monster had a transparent body which looked like a crystal, and it didn’t have any facial figures. No nose, no ears, and no mouth. Right in the middle of its face, there was a crystal eye, which kept staring at Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.

The monster roared out once again. It didn’t have a mouth, but it could still roar loudly. The roar sounded like it came from its body, and it was enough to send shivers down most people’s spines. If any normal man saw this strange monster, he would definitely be scared to the limits and flee immediately.

But Jiang Chen and Big Yellow didn’t move at all. With their judgment, they easily found out the cultivation level of this monster; it was only a Mid Heavenly Core monster. Although it was considered pretty strong, it couldn’t pose any threat to either of them.
“Buddy, can you tell me what kind of monster this is?2
Big Yellow asked.

“I once read a book called the ‘Book of Mysterious Beings’. I recorded all sorts of monster and demons from the ancient era until now. There is a monster called the Nine Life Crystal Beast, and this kind of beast is transparent like a crystal, and has only one eye, no other facial features. It’s a powerful monster, and it very difficult to deal with, because as the name implies, it has nine lives. You have to kill it nine times before it dies.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Damn it, buddy, why does it seem like you know everything?”
Big Yellow felt really depressed. He had followed Jiang Chen for such a long time, but it felt like there was nothing that Jiang Chen didn’t know.
“If I told you I am a reincarnated Saint, would you believe me?”
Jiang Chen looked at Big Yellow with a smile on his face.
“I believe! Even if you were to say you are a fucking reincarnated immortal, I would still believe you!”

Big Yellow nodded his head. If this was said by some other person, Big Yellow would definitely look at him as if he was an idiot, he would then turn around and leave. But since it was told by Jiang Chen, Big Yellow did partly believe in him, because no 16 year old should know so much.

The Nine Life Crystal Beast roared out once again. It didn’t feel surprised when looking at the human in front of it. Obviously, it had seen quite a lot of humans in Inferno Hello. Besides, this Nine Life Crystal Beast had a clear hostility towards humans. It carried an extreme killing intention as it quickly sprinted towards Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
“Since this guy is seeking his death, let’s see if it really has nine lives, just like you said.”
Big Yellow was laughing out loudly in excitement. In an instant, he dashed towards the crystal beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 199 - The Usage of the Crystal Core
paragraphs: Bang!

Big Yellow’s head was probably one of the hardest things in this world. The indestructible Nine Life Crystal Beast’s body shattered instantly because of the impact, it turned into pieces of crystals and scarred across the place.
“Kaka, so weak!”

Big Yellow was laughing out loudly. However, before he could finish his words, an expression of shock emerged on his face. He could see the broken crystal pieces assembling back to normal in an instant, making the Nine Life Crystal Beast whole again.
Roar!

The Nine Life Crystal Beast was extremely angry. It roared out in fury as it dashed towards Big Yellow once again. This Nine Life Crystal Beast was a rare and unique life form, it didn’t possess any kind of innate ability, it only relied on its body’s strength. It could rip anything apart. Besides, the bright light that shot out from its body could cause devastating damage. Anyone who got hit by it would either die or suffer severe injuries.
“Damn it, don’t tell me it really has nine lives!”
Big Yellow felt somewhat depressed. He had never seen any living being like this before, it was simply something that couldn’t be killed.
“I don’t believe this.”

Big Yellow leapt forwards once again, and with a loud bang, he smashed the Nine Life Crystal Beast into pieces one more time. Big Yellow was never scared of anyone when it came to comparing body’s strength.
But in an instant, the shattered Nine Life Crystal Beast restored back to its original shape, which looked and felt exactly like it did before.
“Fuck you!”

Big Yellow’s fury ignited. Just as the Nine Life Crystal Beast assembled back into one piece, he sprinted and smashed it into pieces one more time. This time, he stepped on some of the broken crystal pieces.
“Daddy will just step on you! Let’s see how you are going assemble once again!”
Big Yellow was pissed off. Jiang Chen, who was standing on the other side, was shaking his head, as he knew that this was useless.
Indeed, the broken pieces of crystals disappeared from under his feet, and in an instant, the Nine Life Crystal Beast assembled its whole body once again.
“Damn it!”
Big Yellow couldn’t remain calm any longer.

“Big Yellow, that’s useless, the Nine Life Crystal Beast is a unique life form in this world, you must kill it nine time before it completely dies. Even if you make it disappear from the face of the planet, it will still appear again.”
Jiang Chen said with a laugh.
“Damn it, this abnormal monster! Buddy, if you could absorb this ability, that would be awesome! Who would be able to kill you in the future if you had this ability?”
Big Yellow said.
“Kill it first before we discuss that.”
Jiang Chen waved his hand and asked Big Yellow to hurry up and finish the fight.
“Alright!”
Big Yellow’s ears stood up, and he unleashed all his energy, then he once again leapt onto the monster.
Bang bang bang...

Smashing into it five times in a row, the Nine Life Crystal Beast had been killed 8 times. After being killed 8 times, the Nine Life Crystal Beast immediately turned around and started fleeing with extreme speed. This rare beast did possess basic intelligence, so after having been killed 8 times, it finally understood how powerful its opponent was. If it continued fighting, it would get itself killed here.
“Trying to run? Kaka!”
Big Yellow burst into laughter. It would be really shameful if he let a Mid Heavenly Core monster escape from him.
Bang!
Another loud banging sound was heard. Although the Nine Life Crystal Beast was fast, it still couldn’t compare with Big Yellow. Once again, Big Yellow smashed into it, and it finally died.
Buzz...
Followed by a buzzing sound, the broken crystal pieces which were shattered around the place formed into a fist-sized crystal ball which floated in the middle of the air.
“What’s this?”
Big Yellow was startled.
“This is something good.”

Jiang Chen had quick hands. In an instant, he grabbed the crystal ball with his hand, then he said, “This is the Nine Life Crystal Beast’s crystal core, and it contains its real essence. It only drops upon completely killing the Nine Life Crystal Beast.”
“What’s the usage of this crystal core? Is it any different than a demon soul?”
Big Yellow asked.

“Huge difference! No human can absorb demon souls or devil souls without purifying them first, but this crystal core is different. According to the records in ancient books, the Nine Life Crystal Beast is born from nature after having absorbed natural energy essence. Not only does this crystal core contain huge amounts of pure energies, it also contains natural source energy, which allows any human cultivator to absorb it directly. The benefits it provides are even greater than what you can get from an energy vein. Don’t underestimate this tiny crystal core, if we can bring it out from here, then we can sell it for some good money.”
Jiang Chen said.
“So that’s what it is.”

Big Yellow’s ears fell down in an instant. He thought there would tremendous benefit from this crystal core, but he wasn’t attracted to it as he had the Dragon Horse bloodline, and could easily break through with help of his bloodline. Therefore, he didn’t have any need for this crystal core.
Jiang Chen wasn’t surprised by Big Yellow’s response. This crystal core was useless for him, but for all human cultivators, it was a priceless treasure.

“Finally, I know why there are so many people who are risking their lives in Inferno Hell. Besides, they also get to experience life and death situations. I’m sure there are a lot of Nine Life Crystal Beast’s here, we are going to make a fortune this trip!”
A bright smile appeared on Jiang Chen’s face. This really was a massive amount of wealth. However, getting the crystal cores was no easy task.

“If people have come here specifically for these crystal cores, I’ll call them idiots! If a human bumps into a Nine Life Crystal Beast which is at the same level as him, it will surely end with him dying! He would simply stand no chance at killing it. Even if he is one level higher than it, it will still be a risky fight.”

Big Yellow said. The Nine Life Crystal Beast possess nine lives, and it also posses powerful combat strength. No matter how powerful a person was, it would still be tiring to kill a monster nine times.
“That’s none of our business. The thing is, we are going to get his wealth no matter what. Since we are here, we need to get something good.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile on his face.
“Buddy, since you can easily absorb demon souls and devil souls, is this crystal core any different for you?”
Big Yellow asked in disdain.

“There is no difference for me. But, we can bring this with us and exchange it for great wealth. I’m sure there are a lot of people thirsting for it. Besides, we can give these crystal cores to our friends.”
Jiang Chen explained. There were countless benefits provided by the crystal cores. Worst case, they would just absorb the cores themselves.
“If there really are so many Nine Life Crystal Beasts here, why have we never seen any crystal cores before?”
Big Yellow asked.

“Are you an idiot? Only after realizing how strong these Nine Life Crystal Beasts are will you know how difficult it is to obtain a crystal core. Once someone gets one, they will usually use it themselves, and won’t easily show it to other people. Besides, while we were hanging around in the Qi Province, there were only a handful of people who had the courage to come here. And even if they do come here, people rarely make it out alive.”
Jiang Chen gazed at Big Yellow with despise. Usually, this dog was smart, so why couldn’t he understand this simple reasoning?
“You are an idiot! Hurry up and absorb this crystal core, let’s see if you can inherit the nine lives ability!”
Big Yellow’s eyes lit up as he stared at Jiang Chen. If Jiang Chen really was able to obtain this ability, that would awesome.

“You’re thinking too much. The Nine Life Crystal Beast is just an unique life form, they are not considered a true beast. Also, their nine lives is not really an innate ability. The crystal core is just an energy source. But, since you mentioned t, I’ll give it a try.

Jiang Chen swallowed the crystal core, then he circulated the Dragon Transformation skill and absorbed the entire crystal core in an instant. However, just as he had thought, the crystal core was just an energy source. A Mid Heavenly Core crystal core couldn’t even help him for a single Dragon Mark. As for the nine lives, that was just a wild dream.
“How is it?”
Big Yellow asked with anticipation.

“Nothing. But, the energy contained within this crystal core is really pure, and the natural energy essence can even strengthen my foundation, so I felt really refreshed after absorbing it. I think I’ll kill some more of these Nine Life Crystal Beasts. I’ll store away those low level crystal cores, and absorb the high level ones. If I can absorb them together with some devil or demon souls, not only can it increase my combat strength and cultivation level, they can also strengthen my foundation and help me maintain a strong foundation when I break through to the Divine Core realm.”

Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up. The effects of the crystal core to him were really great. He previously consumed the Five Elemental Pill to strengthen his foundation, preventing it from being shaken upon leveling up too quickly. The more advanced his cultivation became, the more he would need to strengthen his foundation.
And this crystal core could give him this result. It was like it was specially prepared for Jiang Chen.
“Damn it, why does benefits always go to you? This master dog never gets anything good!”
Big Yellow said with a depressed tone.

“Big Yellow, you possess the noble Dragon Horse bloodline, it’s the most privileged existence in this world. Not only are you handsome and unconventional, mighty and majestic, you can even break through while you’re sleeping! You’re simply the mightiest existence in this world, even I have to throw myself down at your feet in admiration. You don’t need help from these crystal cores, am I right?”

Jiang Chen used the most effective way to handle Big Yellow, he just kept flattering him, making him happy and excited. Saliva was dripping all over the place, and Big Yellow’s head was raised up high.
“Buddy, you really know me well! The master dog is the mightiest being in this world, of course I don’t need these tiny things!”
Big Yellow stood up on his legs like a human and turned around.

“Alright, let’s begin our journey in Inferno Hell. I suppose this place is only the outer perimeter, so let’s move out from this abyss and start going towards the depths of Inferno Hell. It’s better if we could bump into someone so we can learn more about this place.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Fine.”
Big Yellow nodded his head.

The duo leapt forwards and start flying in a straight line away from the abyss. In front of them, there was a grayish desolated area with rocks scarred all over the place. There were also some thick woods, and some strange plants growing within.
“The place is filled with all kinds of demon and devil energies. I can also sense the energies of the Nine Life Crystal Beasts. Foul monsters are everywhere, we need to be extra careful.”
Jiang Chen reminded Big Yellow. The Evil Devil and the Nine Life Crystal Beast were just some appetizers, the real dangers of Inferno Hell was still ahead of them.

“No matter what kind of foul demons or devils come, they will flee immediately upon bumping into the master dog... No, they will worship me, they will throw themselves down at my feet and admire my mightiness!”
Big Yellow became narcissistic again.

Big Yellow asked.
“Huge difference!
No human can absorb demon souls or devil souls without purifying them first, but this crystal core is different.
According to the records in ancient books, the Nine Life Crystal Beast is born from nature after having absorbed natural energy essence.
Not only does this crystal core contain huge amounts of pure energies, it also contains natural source energy, which allows any human cultivator to absorb it directly.
The benefits it provides are even greater than what you can get from an energy vein.
Don’t underestimate this tiny crystal core, if we can bring it out from here, then we can sell it for some good money.”
Jiang Chen said.
“So that’s what it is.”
Big Yellow’s ears fell down in an instant.
He thought there would tremendous benefit from this crystal core, but he wasn’t attracted to it as he had the Dragon Horse bloodline, and could easily break through with help of his bloodline.
Therefore, he didn’t have any need for this crystal core.
Jiang Chen wasn’t surprised by Big Yellow’s response.
This crystal core was useless for him, but for all human cultivators, it was a priceless treasure.
“Finally, I know why there are so many people who are risking their lives in Inferno Hell.
Besides, they also get to experience life and death situations.
I’m sure there are a lot of Nine Life Crystal Beast’s here, we are going to make a fortune this trip!”
A bright smile appeared on Jiang Chen’s face.
This really was a massive amount of wealth.
However, getting the crystal cores was no easy task.
“If people have come here specifically for these crystal cores, I’ll call them idiots!
If a human bumps into a Nine Life Crystal Beast which is at the same level as him, it will surely end with him dying!
He would simply stand no chance at killing it.
Even if he is one level higher than it, it will still be a risky fight.”
Big Yellow said.
The Nine Life Crystal Beast possess nine lives, and it also posses powerful combat strength.
No matter how powerful a person was, it would still be tiring to kill a monster nine times.
“That’s none of our business.
The thing is, we are going to get his wealth no matter what.
Since we are here, we need to get something good.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile on his face.
“Buddy, since you can easily absorb demon souls and devil souls, is this crystal core any different for you?”
Big Yellow asked in disdain.
“There is no difference for me.
But, we can bring this with us and exchange it for great wealth.
I’m sure there are a lot of people thirsting for it.
Besides, we can give these crystal cores to our friends.”
Jiang Chen explained.
There were countless benefits provided by the crystal cores.
Worst case, they would just absorb the cores themselves.
“If there really are so many Nine Life Crystal Beasts here, why have we never seen any crystal cores before?”
Big Yellow asked.
“Are you an idiot?
Only after realizing how strong these Nine Life Crystal Beasts are will you know how difficult it is to obtain a crystal core.
Once someone gets one, they will usually use it themselves, and won’t easily show it to other people.
Besides, while we were hanging around in the Qi Province, there were only a handful of people who had the courage to come here.
And even if they do come here, people rarely make it out alive.”
Jiang Chen gazed at Big Yellow with despise.
Usually, this dog was smart, so why couldn’t he understand this simple reasoning?
“You are an idiot!
Hurry up and absorb this crystal core, let’s see if you can inherit the nine lives ability!”
Big Yellow’s eyes lit up as he stared at Jiang Chen.
If Jiang Chen really was able to obtain this ability, that would awesome.
“You’re thinking too much.
The Nine Life Crystal Beast is just an unique life form, they are not considered a true beast.
Also, their nine lives is not really an innate ability.
The crystal core is just an energy source.
But, since you mentioned t, I’ll give it a try.
Jiang Chen swallowed the crystal core, then he circulated the Dragon Transformation skill and absorbed the entire crystal core in an instant.
However, just as he had thought, the crystal core was just an energy source.
A Mid Heavenly Core crystal core couldn’t even help him for a single Dragon Mark.
As for the nine lives, that was just a wild dream.
“How is it?”
Big Yellow asked with anticipation.
“Nothing.
But, the energy contained within this crystal core is really pure, and the natural energy essence can even strengthen my foundation, so I felt really refreshed after absorbing it.
I think I’ll kill some more of these Nine Life Crystal Beasts.
I’ll store away those low level crystal cores, and absorb the high level ones.

If I can absorb them together with some devil or demon souls, not only can it increase my combat strength and cultivation level, they can also strengthen my foundation and help me maintain a strong foundation when I break through to the Divine Core realm.”
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up.
The effects of the crystal core to him were really great.
He previously consumed the Five Elemental Pill to strengthen his foundation, preventing it from being shaken upon leveling up too quickly.
The more advanced his cultivation became, the more he would need to strengthen his foundation.
And this crystal core could give him this result.
It was like it was specially prepared for Jiang Chen.
“Damn it, why does benefits always go to you?
This master dog never gets anything good!”
Big Yellow said with a depressed tone.
“Big Yellow, you possess the noble Dragon Horse bloodline, it’s the most privileged existence in this world.
Not only are you handsome and unconventional, mighty and majestic, you can even break through while you’re sleeping!
You’re simply the mightiest existence in this world, even I have to throw myself down at your feet in admiration.
You don’t need help from these crystal cores, am I right?”
Jiang Chen used the most effective way to handle Big Yellow, he just kept flattering him, making him happy and excited.
Saliva was dripping all over the place, and Big Yellow’s head was raised up high.
“Buddy, you really know me well!
The master dog is the mightiest being in this world, of course I don’t need these tiny things!”
Big Yellow stood up on his legs like a human and turned around.
“Alright, let’s begin our journey in Inferno Hell.
I suppose this place is only the outer perimeter, so let’s move out from this abyss and start going towards the depths of Inferno Hell.
It’s better if we could bump into someone so we can learn more about this place.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Fine.”
Big Yellow nodded his head.
The duo leapt forwards and start flying in a straight line away from the abyss.
In front of them, there was a grayish desolated area with rocks scarred all over the place.
There were also some thick woods, and some strange plants growing within.
“The place is filled with all kinds of demon and devil energies.
I can also sense the energies of the Nine Life Crystal Beasts.
Foul monsters are everywhere, we need to be extra careful.”
Jiang Chen reminded Big Yellow.
The Evil Devil and the Nine Life Crystal Beast were just some appetizers, the real dangers of Inferno Hell was still ahead of them.
“No matter what kind of foul demons or devils come, they will flee immediately upon bumping into the master dog...
No, they will worship me, they will throw themselves down at my feet and admire my mightiness!”
Big Yellow became narcissistic again.

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - Two-Headed Black Crow
paragraphs: Caw~

Just as Big Yellow finished performing his narcissistic speech, a huge object suddenly got in their way. It was a huge black crow with two heads. It was 3 meters tall, and it was fully covered with black scales. It seemed fierce, and can easily scare someone with its looks alone.
Swoosh...
Black fog kept rising from the Black Crow’s body. A pair of evil eyes stared at Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, it had decided them to be its prey.
“Big Yellow, didn’t you just say that all foul devils and demons were going to throw themselves underneath you feet just now?”
Jiang Chen would never let go of any opportunity to tease Big Yellow.
“Damn it, what kind of monster is this two headed black crow? This Inferno Hell is such a weird place! We’ve only been here for a short time, and we have already bumped into three weird beings!”

Big Yellow felt like throwing up some blood. He wasn’t scared of the black crow at all. Although it was stronger than the Evil Devil and Nine Life Crystal Beast they previously fight, it was only at the Late Heavenly Core realm. It wasn’t Big Yellow’s match if they did fight.
What pissed Big Yellow off was that this black crow had appeared immediately after he had delivered his narcissistic speech. It really didn’t show any respect to Big Yellow at all.
“Inferno Hell is indeed a special place, it even has someone that hasn’t been recording in the Book of Mysterious Beings. I can’t even tell the name of this double headed black crow.”
Jiang Chen inwardly let out a sigh. The devil and demon beasts in Inferno Hell were really unique, there were even some that Jiang Chen couldn’t recognize.
“I don’t care what kind of devil or demon beast this is, let master dog kill it first!”
Big Yellow’s fighting spirit rose tremendously. His head was glowing in a golden light, and in an instant, he turned into a beam of light as he forcefully rammed towards the black crow.
Swoosh!
In a split second, the black crow flapped its wings and dodged Big Yellow’s attack.
“What?”

Not only was Big Yellow shocked, even Jiang Chen felt surprised. Both of them were shock by the black crow’s speed. Jiang Chen knew how fast Big Yellow’s attack was, but this black crow was still able to completely dodge the attack.
Caw!
After dodging the attack, with speed great as lightning, the black crow initiated a counter-attack towards Big Yellow. It was using its long and sharp beak to peck towards Big Yellow.
“Hmph! I don’t believe you’re actually faster than me!”
Big Yellow let out a cold snort. He had become angry by the fact that a demon beast the same level as him could actually dodge his attack. This really insulted his pride.
The black crow was extremely fast, but Big Yellow was even faster. In an instant, he turned his huge body and pointed his head towards the black crow.

When the black crow saw Big Yellow using his head to try and block its attack, a scornful look emerged in its eyes. It knew that its sharp beak could penetrate any tough objects, but this dog actually didn’t try to avoid it, and was using his head to block it. Wasn’t this an act of seeking death?
Clang!

Too bad, the black crow’s expression changed immediately when its beak hit Big Yellow’s head. A metal clanging sound was heard when its powerful beak collided with Big Yellow’s head, and the scene of Big Yellow’s head being destroyed didn’t happen. Not only did the attack not hurt Big Yellow, it couldn’t even leave a mark on his head.
Caw!
The double headed black crow let out a loud cry. An intense shock emerged in its eyes when it felt the pain in its beak.

Jiang Chen who was standing on the sidelines shook his head. This black crow was strong, and its sharp beak could be considered a magnificent weapon, but compared to Big Yellow’s head, it was still far away from being able to defeat him. Besides, although the black crow was overbearing, its cultivation level was still too low, it was only at the Late Heavenly Core realm. No matter how overbearing a demon beast or devil was, none would be Big Yellow’s match if they were in the same realm and stage as him.
Caw!
When the black crow found out that Big Yellow’s body was indestructible, it immediately opened its mouth and spat out two lumps of black mist, which shot towards Big Yellow like two sharp swords.
“Big Yellow, be careful, that mist is poisonous.”

Jiang Chen could immediately tell the characteristics of the mist, it actually carried a deadly poison. The Double-Headed Black Crow was not an Evil Devil, but it did possess dark elements like the Evil Devil did, as well as some poisons within its body.
Puh!

Big Yellow didn’t look scared at all. He opened up his mouth and spat out a golden colored energy beam, which dispersed the poisonous mist in an instant. Although some of it still touched his body, it was unable to affect Big Yellow at all.

Only now did Jiang Chen recall; when he first met Big Yellow, Jiang Chen had attacked with the Green Hellish Python’s poison, and it had no effect on this guy. Big Yellow was invincible against poison.
“Die for daddy now!”
Big Yellow was furious. With his pride, it brought him great shame to fight a black crow at the same level as himself.

A pair of light wings appeared on Big Yellow’s back, and it doubled his speed. In the blink of an eye, he sprinted up to the black crow. This time, the black crow was unable to dodge his attack. Big Yellow crushed its head with his mighty head in an instant.
Caw...
The black crow cried out miserably. After that, it let out a weird melody toward the skies.
“Oh no, it is calling for help.”
Jiang Chen’s expression changed slightly, he didn’t want to get attacked by a huge flock of black crows. He immediately unleashed the True Dragon Palm and crushed the black crow into ashes.
Two black colored demon souls dropped out from the ashes. Jiang Chen extended his hand and grabbed both of them at the same time.
“The black crow has two heads, that must be why it has two demon souls in its body.. not bad.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile.
“Buddy, I almost killed it just now, why did you snatch away my prey?”
Big Yellow looked at Jiang Chen with anger.
“Save your breath, let’s leave this place as quickly as possible. The black crow was calling for its mates just now. Before we know more about this place, I’d rather not get into too much trouble.”
Jiang Chen said.

Too bad, although he didn’t want to pursues trouble right now, trouble would still pursue him. Just as Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were about to leave, noisy sounds could be heard from the woods in front of them. After that, a huge flock of black crows flew out like a storm and surrounded Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
“The fuck? How come there are so many double headed black crows?”

Big Yellow cursed out. There were at least 40 black crows surrounding them, and they were all at least at the Heavenly Core realm. Some of them were even at the peak Heavenly Core realm, which is stronger than the black crow they had just killed. The leading black crow had a body twice as big as the other black crows; it was a Divine Core beast.

Big Yellow’s face darkened. If it was any other ordinary demon beasts, it wouldn’t scare them no matter how many of them there were. However, the black crows were insanely fast, and the Divine Core black crow would be even faster. Surrounded by a huge group of black crows meant huge trouble for them.

“Big Yellow, let’s kill them quickly and leave this place. I’m these black crows live in a group, and their nests must be somewhere nearby. There might be some even stronger creatures here, and if we are trapped by hundreds, or even thousands of these black crows, we’ll be in deep shit.”

Jiang Chen strengthened his spirit as he told Big Yellow. These kinds of demon beasts who lived in groups were the most frightening. Once trapped by them, the attacks would be endless. Besides, these black crows were extremely fast, and they could even attack with poisonous mist. They were not easy to deal with.

Right at this moment, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow finally understood the frightening part about Inferno Hell, and why so many people became scared upon mentioning it. They had just arrived here not too long ago, and they had already bumped into a large group of savage black crows. If it was just a single man who bumped into this group of black crows, even if he was a Divine Core warrior, what awaited him was certain death.
“Damn it, these guys are extremely quick, it’s easier said than done to quickly kill them!”
Big Yellow felt somewhat depressed.

“These black crows are demon beasts of the dark elements, and you possess the purest Yang bloodline of all Divine Beasts, which is the perfect rival for them. As for me, I have powerful blood and qi, which is also powerful against them. I will burn them with my True Dragon Flames.”
Jiang Chen said. Right now, there were black crows everywhere, and in order to get out from here, or even kill these black crows, they had to use some massive attacks.
Caw!
The leading black crow cried out loudly. Immediately, all the black crows pointed their sharp beaks towards Jiang Chen and Big Yellow. They flapped their wings and rushed towards their targets.
“Damn you, com on, I’ll let you taste the mightiness of this master dog!”
Big Yellow finally became violent. A golden barrier appeared outside his body, and he suddenly sped towards the flock of black crows.
Bang!
Big Yellow acted like a brutal ancient savage beast. His first charged cause three black crows to explode into blood mists.
“True Dragon Flames, burn them all!”
Jiang Chen shouted out loudly. He waved his hand and unleashed a sea of flames which immediately engulfed six black crows.

The black crows seemed like they had witnessed something really terrifying and bumped into their natural enemies. All of them let out panicked cries. The black crows who were engulfed by the True Dragon Flames couldn’t resist the scorching heat, and were immediately burned to ashes.
“They really fear the True Dragon Flames!”

Jiang Chen was majestic like a dragon, he unleashed another sea of flames which covered another group of black crows. The black crows immediately struggled and rolled around within the flames, but they couldn’t escape. Soon, they were all killed by the intense flames.
The True Dragon Flame was the king of all beast flames. It was a fearful attack, and it was the biggest enemy of all dark element beings.
Caw!

Looking at what was happening, the leading black crow let out a shrill cry once again. Immediately, all the other black crows, as if they had received a command, threw themselves at Jiang Chen without considered their own safety.
“Hmph! I’ll kill you all!”

Jiang Chen let out a cold snort. He unleashed the True Dragon Flames and covered all the black crows who were approaching. At the same time, the Divine Core black crow attacked Jiang Chen from behind.

The leading black crow was using its own peoples’ lives in order to tie Jiang Chen up, so it could launch a sneak attack from behind. If any other person had fallen into the trip, he would most likely be dead by now. But too bad, it was Jiang Chen whom they were trying to attack.
“Trying to sneak attack me? You lack the skills do to so! True Dragon Palm!”
Jiang Chen had an indifferent expression. He was cultivating the Great Soul Derivation skill, and that made him sensitive to his surrounding. No one could successfully sneak attack him.
Bang!
A blood red dragon claw descended from the skies and covered the leading black crow like a gigantic prison.
Caw!
The leading black crow let out a loud cry. It pecked towards the True Dragon Balm with its sharp beak and poked a huge hole into it. This really showed how strong its beak was.
But Jiang Chen would never give it the chance to escape. In an instant, he unleashed the True Dragon Flames within the gigantic dragon claw.
